description: Treat 1s on spell damage dice as 2s. Once per dawn, on a Short Rest, recover expended spell slots totalling up to level 3.

name: Spell-Slinger's Puppet
description: Bonus Action: the doll hovers within 30 ft for 1 minute and moves 30 ft per Bonus Action. You can speak through it, including Verbal components when you can't speak.

name: Spellguard Shield
description: While holding this Shield, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and spell attack rolls have Disadvantage against you. Spell Scroll Scroll, Rarity Varies A Spell Scroll bears the words of a single spell, writ ten in a mystical cipher. If the spell is on your spell list, you can read the scroll and cast its spell with out Material components. Otherwise, the scroll is unintelligible. Casting the spell by reading the scroll requires the spell’s normal casting time. Once the spell is cast, the scroll crumbles to dust. If the cast ing is interrupted, the scroll isn’t lost. If the spell is on your spell list but of a higher level than you can normally cast, you make an ability check using your spellcasting ability to determine whether you cast the spell. The DC equals 10 plus the spell’s level. On a failed check, the spell disap pears from the scroll with no other effect. The level of the spell on the scroll determines the spell’s saving throw DC and attack bonus, as well as the scroll’s rarity, as shown in the following table. Spell Level Rarity Save DC Attack Bonus Cantrip Common 13 +5 1 Common 13 +5 2 Uncommon 13 +5 3 Uncommon 15 +7 Spell Level Rarity Save DC Attack Bonus 4 Rare 15 +7 5 Rare 17 +9 6 Very Rare 17 +9 7 Very Rare 18 +10 8 Very Rare 18 +10 9 Legendary 19 +11 Copying a Scroll into a Spellbook. A Wizard spell on a Spell Scroll can be copied into a spellbook. When a spell is copied in this way, the copier must succeed on an Intelligence (Arcana) check with a DC equal to 10 plus the spell’s level. On a successful check, the spell is copied. Whether the check suc ceeds or fails, the Spell Scroll is destroyed.

name: Sphere of Annihilation
description: This 2-foot-diameter black sphere is a hole in the multiverse, hovering in space and stabilized by a magical field surrounding it. The sphere obliterates all matter it passes through and all matter that passes through it. Ar tifacts are the exception. Unless an Artifact is sus ceptible to damage from a Sphere of Annihilation, it passes through the sphere unscathed. Anything else that touches the sphere but isn’t wholly engulfed and obliterated by it takes 8d10 Force damage. Controlling the Sphere. A Sphere of Annihilation is stationary until someone takes control of it. If you are within 60 feet of a sphere, you can take a Magic action to make a DC 25 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a successful check, you control the sphere until the start of your next turn, and if it was under an other creature’s control, that creature loses control of the sphere. On a failed check, the sphere moves 10 feet toward you in a straight line. While in control of the sphere, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to move in one direction of your choice, up to a number of feet equal to 5 times your Intelligence modifier (minimum 5 feet). Any creature whose space the sphere enters must succeed on a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw or be touched by it, taking 8d10 Force damage. A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage is obliterated, leaving its possessions behind but no other physical remains. Sphere Interactions. If the sphere comes into contact with a planar portal (such as that created by the Gate spell) or an extradimensional space (such as that within a Portable Hole ), the GM determines randomly what happens using the following table. 1d100 Result 01–50 The sphere is destroyed. 51–85 The sphere moves through the portal or into the extradimensional space. 86–00 A spatial rift sends the sphere and each crea ture and object within 180 feet of the sphere to a random plane of existence.

name: Spirit-Binding Censer
description: 10 charges, regains 1d6 at dawn. Cast at DC 18: Bless (1), Dispel Magic or Remove Curse (3), Banishment (4), Circle of Power (5).

name: Staff of Charming
description: This staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can use any of its properties: Cast Spell. You can expend 1 of the staff’s charges to cast Charm Person, Command, or Comprehend Languages from it using your spell save DC. Reflect Enchantment. If you succeed on a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge from the staff and turn the spell back on its caster as if you had cast the spell. Resist Enchantment. If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a success ful one. You can’t use this property of the staff again until the next dawn. Regaining Charges. The staff regains 1d8 + 2 ex pended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff crumbles to dust and is destroyed.

name: Staff of Fire
description: You have Resistance to Fire damage while you hold this staff. Spells. The staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table in dicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell. Spell Charge Cost Spell Charge Cost Burning Hands 1 Wall of Fire 4 Fireball 3 Regaining Charges. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff crumbles into cinders and is destroyed.

name: Staff of Frost
description: You have Resistance to Cold damage while you hold this staff. Spells. The staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table in dicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell. Spell Charge Cost Spell Charge Cost Cone of Cold 5 Ice Storm 4 Fog Cloud 1 Wall of Ice 4 Regaining Charges. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 ex pended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff turns to water and is destroyed.

name: Staff of Healing
description: This staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spellcasting ability modifier. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell. Spell Charge Cost Cure Wounds 1 charge per spell level (maximum 4 for a level 4 spell) Lesser Restoration 2 Mass Cure Wounds 5 Regaining Charges. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff vanishes in a flash of light, lost forever.

name: Staff of Power
description: This staff has 20 charges and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. While hold ing it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, saving throws, and spell attack rolls. Spells. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell. Spell Charge Cost Cone of Cold 5 Fireball (level 5 version) 5 Globe of Invulnerability 6 Hold Monster 5 Levitate 2 Lightning Bolt (level 5 version) 5 Magic Missile 1 Ray of Enfeeblement 1 Wall of Force 5 Regaining Charges. The staff regains 2d8 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains 1d8 + 2 charges. Retributive Strike. You can take a Magic action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid sur face. The staff is destroyed and releases its magic in an explosion that fills a 30-foot Emanation originat ing from itself. You have a 50 percent chance to in stantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoid ing the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff. Each other creature in the area makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to 4 times the number of charges in the staff. On a suc cessful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

name: Staff of Skulls
description: Evolving. Ominous (Uncommon): Chill Touch, Advantage on Intimidation, dim green glow. Chattering (Rare): Reaction to impose Disadvantage on an attack roll within 30 ft. Pulverizing (Very Rare): once per dawn, a Humanoid you point at makes a DC 17 Con save for 10d8 Necrotic and Prone (half only on a success).

name: Staff of Striking
description: This staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. The staff has 10 charges. When you hit with a melee attack using it, you can expend up to 3 charges. For each charge you expend, the target takes an extra 1d6 Force damage. Regaining Charges. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff.

name: Staff of Swarming Insects
description: This staff has 10 charges. Insect Cloud. While holding the staff, you can take a Magic action and expend 1 charge to cause a swarm of harmless flying insects to fill a 30foot Emanation originating from you. The insects remain for 10 minutes, making the area Heavily Obscured for creatures other than you. A strong wind (like that created by Gust of Wind ) disperses the swarm and ends the effect. Spells. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC and spell attack modifier. The table in dicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell. Spell Charge Cost Giant Insect 4 Insect Plague 5 Regaining Charges. The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, a swarm of insects consumes and destroys the staff, then disperses.

name: Staff of Thunder and Lightning
description: This staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. It also has the following addi tional properties. Once one of these properties is used, it can’t be used again until the next dawn. Lightning. When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the target to take an extra 2d6 Lightning damage (no action required). Thunder. When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the staff to emit a crack of thunder audible out to 300 feet (no action required). The target you hit must succeed on a DC 17 Consti tution saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn. Thunder and Lightning. Immediately after you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can take a Bonus Action to use the Lightning and Thunder properties (see above) at the same time. Doing so doesn’t expend the daily use of those properties, only the use of this one. Lightning Strike. You can take a Magic action to cause a bolt of lightning to leap from the staff’s tip in a Line that is 5 feet wide and 120 feet long. Each creature in that Line makes a DC 17 Dexterity sav ing throw, taking 9d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Thunderclap. You can take a Magic action to cause the staff to produce a thunderclap audible out to 600 feet. Every creature within a 60-foot Emanation originating from you makes a DC 17 Constitu tion saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 Thunder damage and has the Deafened condi tion for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

name: Staff of Withering
description: This staff has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. The staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff. On a hit, it deals damage as a normal Quarterstaff, and you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra 2d10 Necrotic damage to the target and force it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage for 1 hour on any ability check or saving throw that uses Strength or Constitution.

name: Staff of the Lost
description: +1 Quarterstaff with 3 charges (nonmagical when spent): cast Maze (DC 18) or Teleport. Cursed: you won't part with it, never know north, have Disadvantage on Survival checks to navigate, and each charge spent has a 1 in 20 chance to summon 1d4 hostile Minotaurs of Baphomet.

name: Staff of the Magi
description: This staff has 50 charges and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. While you hold it, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls. Spell Absorption. While holding the staff, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells. In addition, you can take a Reaction when another creature casts a spell that targets only you. If you do, the staff absorbs the magic of the spell, cancel ing its effect and gaining a number of charges equal to the absorbed spell’s level. However, if doing so brings the staff’s total number of charges above 50, the staff explodes as if you activated its Retributive Strike (see below). Spells. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell. Spell Charge Cost Arcane Lock 0 Conjure Elemental 7 Detect Magic 0 Dispel Magic 3 Enlarge/Reduce 0 Fireball (level 7 version) 7 Flaming Sphere 2 Ice Storm 4 Invisibility 2 Knock 2 Light 0 Lightning Bolt (level 7 version) 7 Spell Charge Cost Mage Hand 0 Passwall 5 Plane Shift 7 Protection from Evil and Good 0 Telekinesis 5 Wall of Fire 4 Web 2 Regaining Charges. The staff regains 4d6 + 2 ex pended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 20, the staff regains 1d12 + 1 charges. Retributive Strike. You can take a Magic action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid sur face. The staff is destroyed and releases its magic in an explosion that fills a 30-foot Emanation originat ing from itself. You have a 50 percent chance to in stantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoid ing the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff. Each other creature in the area makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to 6 times the number of charges in the staff. On a suc cessful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

name: Staff of the Python
description: As a Magic action, you can throw this staff so that it lands in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you, causing the staff to become a Giant Constrictor Snake in that space. The snake is under your con trol and shares your Initiative count, taking its turn immediately after yours. On your turn, you can mentally command the snake (no action required) if it is within 60 feet of you and you don’t have the Incapacitated condition. You decide what action the snake takes and where it moves during its turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location. Absent commands from you, the snake defends itself. As a Bonus Action, you can command the snake to revert to staff form in its current space, and you can’t use the staff’s property again for 1 hour. If the snake is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it dies and reverts to its staff form; the staff then shatters and is de stroyed. If the snake reverts to staff form before losing all its Hit Points, it regains all of them.

name: Staff of the Spirit Aegis
description: +3 Quarterstaff; Resistance to Necrotic while held. Once per dawn, a 1-hour 30-ft Emanation gives chosen creatures Resistance to Cold, Necrotic, and Psychic, Advantage against Frightened, and imposes Disadvantage on Undead attacking them. Bonus Action: the skull glows 15 ft bright and reveals Invisible things in its light.

name: Staff of the Woodlands
description: This staff has 6 charges and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls. Spells. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell. Spell Charge Cost Animal Friendship 1 Awaken 5 Barkskin 2 Locate Animals or Plants 2 Pass without Trace 2 Speak with Animals 1 Speak with Plants 3 Wall of Thorns 6 Tree Form. You can take a Magic action to plant one end of the staff in earth in an unoccupied space and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree. The tree is 60 feet tall and has a 5-foot-diameter trunk, and its branches at the top spread out in a 20-foot radius. The tree appears ordinary but radiates a faint aura of Transmutation magic that can be discerned with the Detect Magic spell. While touching the tree and using a Magic action, you return the staff to its normal form. Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff. Regaining Charges. The staff regains 1d6 ex pended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its proper ties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff.

name: Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals
description: While touching this 5-pound stone to the ground, you can take a Magic action to summon an Earth Elemental. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of yourself, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The stone can’t be used this way again until the next dawn. Stone of Good Luck (Luckstone) Wondrous Item, Uncommon (Requires Attunement) While this polished agate is on your person, you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.

name: Sun Blade
description: This item appears to be a sword hilt. Blade of Radiance. While grasping the hilt, you can take a Bonus Action to cause a blade of pure radiance to spring into existence or make the blade disappear. While the blade exists, this magic weapon functions as a Longsword with the Finesse property. If you are proficient with Longswords or Shortswords, you are proficient with the Sun Blade . You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this weapon, which deals Radiant damage instead of Slashing damage. When you hit an Undead with it, that target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage. Sunlight. The sword’s luminous blade emits Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 15 feet. The light is sunlight. While the blade persists, you can take a Magic action to expand or reduce its radius of Bright Light and Dim Light by 5 feet each, to a maximum of 30 feet each or a minimum of 10 feet each.

name: Sweeping Broom
description: Magic action: the broom sweeps a 20-ft square within 60 ft until you stop it.

name: Sword of Life Stealing
category: Weapon (Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword)
description: When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the d20 for the attack roll, that target takes an extra 15 Necrotic damage if it isn’t a Construct or an Undead, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to the amount of Necrotic damage taken.

name: Sword of Sharpness
description: When you attack an object with this magic weapon and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target. When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the d20 for the attack roll, that tar get takes an extra 14 Slashing damage and gains 1 Exhaustion level.

name: Sword of Wounding
category: Weapon (Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword)
description: When you hit a creature with an attack using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra 2d6 Necrotic damage and must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be unable to regain Hit Points for 1 hour. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

name: Talisman of Pure Good
description: This talisman is a mighty symbol of goodness. A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman. Holy Symbol. You can use the talisman as a Holy Symbol. You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it. Pure Rebuke. The talisman has 7 charges. While wearing or holding the talisman, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge and target one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. A flaming fissure opens under the tar get, and the target makes a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. If the target is a Fiend or an Undead, it has Disadvantage on the save. On a failed save, the tar get falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains. On a successful save, the target isn’t cast into the fissure but takes 4d6 Psychic damage from the ordeal. In either case, the fissure then closes, leaving no trace of its existence. When you expend the last charge, the talisman disperses into motes of golden light and is destroyed.

name: Talisman of Ultimate Evil
description: This item symbolizes unrepentant evil. A creature that isn’t a Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Necrotic damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman. Holy Symbol. You can use the talisman as a Holy Symbol. You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it. Ultimate End. The talisman has 6 charges. While wearing or holding the talisman, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge and target one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. A flaming fissure opens under the target, and the target makes a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw. If the target is a Celestial, it has Dis advantage on the save. On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no re mains. On a successful save, the target isn’t cast into the fissure but takes 4d6 Psychic damage from the ordeal. In either case, the fissure then closes, leav ing no trace of its existence. When you expend the last charge, the talisman dissolves into foul-smell ing slime and is destroyed.

name: Talisman of the Sphere
description: While holding or wearing this talisman, you have Advantage on any Intelligence (Arcana) check you make to control a Sphere of Annihilation. In addition, when you start your turn in control of a Sphere of Annihilation, you can take a Magic action to move it 10 feet plus a number of additional feet equal to 10 times your Intelligence modifier. This movement doesn’t have to be in a straight line.

name: Thayan Sword
description: +1 weapon with 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn): 1 charge for Searing, Thunderous, or Wrathful Smite (DC 15). Once per dawn, drop to 1 HP instead of 0 while holding it.

name: Thespian's Playbill
description: Add your Charisma modifier (min +1) to Study-action Intelligence checks.

name: Thief's Thimble
description: Absorbs damage from traps you trigger, with 30 HP; breaks at 0 and you take the rest.

name: Thunderous Greatclub
description: While you are attuned to this magic weapon, your Strength is 20 unless your Strength is already equal to or greater than that score. The weapon deals an extra 1d8 Thunder damage to any creature it hits and an extra 3d8 Thunder damage to objects it hits that aren’t being worn or carried. The weapon has the following additional properties. Clap of Thunder. As a Magic action, you can strike the weapon against a hard surface to create a loud clap of thunder audible out to 300 feet. You also cre ate a 30-foot Cone of thunderous energy. Each creature in the Cone must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition. Nonmag ical objects in the Cone that aren’t being worn or carried take 3d8 Thunder damage. Earthquake. As a Magic action, you can strike the weapon against the ground to create an intense seismic disturbance in a 50-foot-radius circle cen tered on the point of impact. Structures in contact with the ground in that area take 50 Bludgeoning damage, and each creature on the ground in that area must succeed on a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or have the Prone condition. If that creature is also concentrating, it must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw, or its Concentration is broken. In addition, you can cause a 30-foot-deep, 10-foot-wide fissure to open up on the ground any where in the area. Any creature on a spot where the fissure opens must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, falling into the fissure on a failed save or moving with the fissure’s edge on a successful one. Any structure on a spot where the fissure opens col lapses into the fissure. Once you use this property, it can’t be used again until the next dawn.

name: Tome of Clear Thought
description: This book contains memory and logic exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book’s contents and practicing its guidelines, your Intelligence increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic but regains it in a century.

name: Tome of Leadership and Influence
description: This book contains guidelines for influencing and charming others, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book’s contents and practic ing its guidelines, your Charisma increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic but regains it in a century.

name: Tome of Understanding
description: This book contains intuition and insight exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book’s contents and practicing its guidelines, your Wisdom increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

name: Tramontane Armor
description: +1 AC; looks like a robe. Ignore extra movement from snow, ice, rubble, or undergrowth. Once per dawn, a Magic action activates tendrils for 1 minute: each Bonus Action, chosen creatures within 20 ft make a DC 15 Str save or are Grappled (escape DC 15) and pulled 20 ft toward you.

name: Traveler's Pearl
description: Cast Teleport once per dawn.

name: Trick Weapon
category: Weapon (Any Simple or Martial Melee Weapon)
description: Magic action: disguise it as a mundane object (bracelet, comb, crutch, coin, hairpin, bell, pendant, card, quill, or spoon) or change it back. Can't attack while disguised.

name: Trident of Fish Command
description: This magic weapon has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While you carry it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Dominate Beast (save DC 15) from it on a Beast that has a Swim Speed.

name: Universal Pantograph
description: Duplicates any nonmagical item placed inside. Magic action: grow it to hold a Medium creature; with 100 GP of diamond dust, cast Clone on the occupant. The lid then stays shut for 120 days while the clone grows, and that clone needs no vessel.

name: Universal Solvent
description: This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. When found, a tube contains 1d6 + 1 ounces. You can take a Utilize action to pour 1 or more ounces of solvent from the tube onto a surface within reach. Each ounce instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including Sover eign Glue.

name: Vicious Weapon
description: This magic weapon deals an extra 2d6 damage to any creature it hits. This extra damage is of the same type as the weapon’s normal damage.

name: Vorpal Sword
description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, the weapon ignores Resistance to Slashing damage. When you use this weapon to attack a creature that has at least one head and roll a 20 on the d20 for the attack roll, you cut off one of the creature’s heads. The creature dies if it can’t survive without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it has Immunity to Slashing damage, if it doesn’t have or need a head, or if the GM decides that the creature is too big for its head to be cut off with this weapon. Such a creature instead takes an extra 30 Slashing damage from the hit. If the creature has Legendary Resistance, it can expend one daily use of that trait to avoid losing its head, taking the extra damage instead.

name: Wand of Binding
description: This wand has 7 charges. Spells. While holding the wand, you can cast one of the spells (save DC 17) on the following table from it. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell. Spell Charge Cost Hold Monster 5 Hold Person 2 Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Wand of Enemy Detection
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge. For 1 min ute, you know the direction of the nearest creature Hostile to you within 60 feet, but not its distance from you. The wand can sense the presence of Hos tile creatures that are Invisible, ethereal, disguised, or hidden, as well as those in plain sight. The effect ends if you stop holding the wand. Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Wand of Enthralling
description: 4 charges, regains 1d4 at dawn. 1 charge: Enthrall (DC 15).

name: Wand of Fear
description: This wand has 7 charges. Spells. While holding the wand, you can cast one of the spells (save DC 15) on the following table from it. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell. Spell Charge Cost Command (“flee” or “grovel” only) 1 Fear (60-foot Cone) 3 Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Wand of Fireballs
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast Fireball (save DC 15) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the level 3 ver sion of the spell. You can increase the spell’s level by 1 for each additional charge you expend. Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Wand of Freshness
description: 4 charges, regains 1d4 + 1 at dawn. 1 charge: Purify Food and Drink.

name: Wand of Lightning Bolts
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast Lightning Bolt (save DC 15) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the level 3 version of the spell. You can increase the spell’s level by 1 for each additional charge you expend. Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Wand of Magic Detection
description: This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Detect Magic from it. The wand regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast Magic Missile from it. For 1 charge, you cast the level 1 version of the spell. You can increase the spell’s level by 1 for each additional charge you expend. Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Wand of Paralysis
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge to cause a thin blue ray to streak from the tip toward a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Paralyzed condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the target’s turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Wand of Polymorph
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Polymorph (save DC 15) from it. Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Wand of Secrets
description: This wand has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge, and if a se cret door or trap is within 60 feet of you, the wand pulses and points at the one nearest to you.

name: Wand of Slumber
description: 7 charges, regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn (1 in 20 to be destroyed on the last). Sleep (DC 15) for 1 charge or Catnap for 3.

name: Wand of Teeth
description: 10 charges, regains 1d10 at dawn (1 in 20 to be destroyed on the last). Magic action, 1 to 3 charges: 30-ft Cone, DC 15 Dex save, that many d8 Piercing and Poisoned until your next turn; half damage only on a success.

name: Wand of Web
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Web (save DC 13) from it. Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Wand of Wonder
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge while choos ing a point within 120 feet of yourself. That location becomes the point of origin of a spell or other magical effect determined by rolling on the Wand of Wonder Effects table. Spells cast from the wand have a save DC of 15. If a spell’s maximum range is normally less than 120 feet, it becomes 120 feet when cast from the wand. If an effect has multiple possible subjects, the GM determines randomly which among them are affected. Regaining Charges. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand’s last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into dust and is destroyed. Wand of Wonder Effects 1d100 Effect 01–20 You cast a spell originating from the chosen point. Roll 1d10 to determine the spell: on a 1–2, Darkness; on a 3–4, Faerie Fire; on a 5–6, Fireball; on a 7–8, Slow; on a 9–10, Stinking Cloud. 21–25 Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you have the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn, believing some thing awesome just happened. 26–30 You cast Gust of Wind. The Line created by the spell extends from you to the chosen point of origin. 31–35 Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you take 1d6 Psychic damage. 36–40 Heavy rain falls for 1 minute in a 120-foothigh, 60-foot-radius Cylinder centered on the chosen point of origin. During that time, the area of effect is Lightly Obscured. 41–45 A cloud of 600 oversized butterflies fills a 60-foot-high, 30-foot-radius Cylinder centered on the chosen point of origin. The butterflies remain for 10 minutes, during which time the area of effect is Heavily Obscured. 46–50 You cast Lightning Bolt . The Line created by the spell extends from you to the chosen point of origin. 51–55 The creature closest to the chosen point of origin is enlarged as if you had cast Enlarge/ Reduce on it. If the target isn’t you and can’t be affected by that spell, you become the target instead. 56–60 A magically formed creature appears in an unoccupied space as close to the chosen point of origin as possible. The creature isn’t under your control, acts as it normally would, and disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 Hit Points. Roll 1d4 to determine which crea ture appears. On a 1, a Rhinoceros appears; on a 2, an Elephant appears; and on a 3–4, a Rat appears. 61–64 Grass covers a 60-foot-radius circle of ground, with the center of that circle as close to the chosen point of origin as possible. Grass that’s already there grows to ten times its normal size and remains overgrown for 1 minute. 1d100 Effect 65–68 An object of the GM’s choice disappears into the Ethereal Plane. The object must be neither worn nor carried, within 120 feet of the cho sen point of origin, and no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. If there are no such objects in range, nothing happens. 69–72 Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you shrink as if you had cast Enlarge/ Reduce on yourself and remain in that state for 1 minute. 73–77 Leaves grow from the creature nearest to the chosen point of origin. Unless they are picked off, the leaves turn brown and fall off after 24 hours. 78–82 Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, a burst of colorful, shimmering light extends from you in a 30-foot Emanation. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition for 1 minute. A creature re peats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. 83–87 Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you cast Invisibility on yourself. 88–92 Nothing happens at the chosen point of ori gin. Instead, a stream of 1d4 × 10 gems, each worth 1 GP, shoots from the wand’s tip in a Line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide toward the chosen point of origin. Each gem deals 1 Blud geoning damage, and the total damage of the gems is divided equally among all creatures in the Line. 93–97 You cast Polymorph, targeting the creature closest to the chosen point of origin. Roll 1d4 to determine the target’s new form. On a 1, the new form is a Black Bear; on a 2, the new form is a Giant Wasp; on a 3–4, the new form is a Frog. 98–00 The creature closest to the chosen point of origin makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the Restrained condition and begins to turn to stone. While Restrained in this way, the crea ture repeats the save at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failed save, the creature has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the Greater Restoration spell or similar magic.

name: Wand of the War Mage, +1, +2, or +3
description: While holding this wand, you gain a bonus to spell attack rolls determined by the wand’s rarity. In ad dition, you ignore Half Cover when making a spell attack roll.

name: Wave-Swept Weapon
category: Weapon (Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword)
description: Evolving. Barnacled (Uncommon): +1 and turn a gallon of liquid briny. Aquatic (Rare): +2, glows, water breathing and Swim 30 ft. Ascendant (Very Rare): +3 and Fly 30 ft while held.

name: Weapon of Warning
description: Attunement) As long as this weapon is within your reach and you are attuned to it, you and allies within 30 feet of you gain the following benefits. Alarm. The weapon magically awakens each sub ject who is sleeping naturally when combat begins. This benefit doesn’t wake a subject from magically induced sleep. Supernatural Readiness. Each subject has Advan tage on its Initiative rolls.

name: Weapon, +1, +2, or +3
description: (+2), or Very Rare (+3) You have a bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus is deter mined by the weapon’s rarity.

name: Well of Many Worlds
description: This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a cir cular sheet 6 feet in diameter. You can take a Magic action to unfold the Well of Many Worlds and place it on a solid surface, where upon it forms a two-way, 6-foot-diameter, circular portal to another world or plane of existence. Each time the item opens a portal, the GM decides where it leads. The portal remains open until a creature within 5 feet of it takes a Magic action to close it by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up. Once the Well of Many Worlds has opened a portal, it can’t do so again for 1d8 hours.

name: Wind Fan
description: While holding this fan, you can cast Gust of Wind (save DC 13) from it. Each subsequent time the fan is used before the next dawn, it has a cumulative 20 percent chance of not working; if the fan fails to work, it tears into useless, nonmagical tatters.

name: Winged Boots
description: These boots have 4 charges and regain 1d4 ex pended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the boots, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge, gaining a Fly Speed of 30 feet for 1 hour. If you are flying when the duration expires, you de scend at a rate of 30 feet per round until you land.

name: Wings of Flying
description: While wearing this cloak, you can take a Magic ac tion to turn the cloak into a pair of wings on your back. The wings lasts for 1 hour or until you end the effect early as a Magic action. The wings give you a Fly Speed of 60 feet. If you are aloft when the wings disappear, you fall. When the wings disappear, you can’t use them again for 1d12 hours.

name: Workshop Wrecker
description: Magic action once per dawn: a ricocheting ball for 1 minute. On activation and each of your turns, creatures in the enclosed space make a Dex save for Bludgeoning damage scaled to room size: 15-ft Cube DC 18, 6d6 + 5; 30-ft DC 17, 4d6 + 4; 50-ft DC 15, 2d6 + 2; 100-ft DC 14, 1d6 + 1. Outdoors it just flies away.

name: Adamantine Weapon
description: Every hit this weapon or piece of ammunition makes against an object is a Critical Hit.

name: Alchemy Jug
description: Magic action: name a liquid from its table (acid, basic poison, beer, honey, mayonnaise, oil, vinegar, fresh or salt water, wine) and pour it as a Utilize action, up to 2 gallons a minute. Each liquid has a daily maximum; once it starts a liquid it cannot switch until the next dawn.

name: Apparatus of Kwalish
description: A 500-pound iron barrel (DC 20 Investigation to find the hatch) that two Medium creatures can crew; ten levers turn it into a Large lobster-like vehicle (AC 20, 200 HP, Speed and Swim 30 feet, airtight, dives to 900 feet) with claws, lights and other lever functions.

name: Armor of Gleaming
description: This armor never gets dirty.

name: Axe of the Dwarvish Lords
description: A +3 battleaxe; a natural 20 adds 20 Slashing, it is Thrown (20/60) and returns to your hand, and ranged hits add 1d8 Force (2d8 against Giants). Attuned: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60), Constitution +2 (max 20), proficiency with Brewer's, Mason's and Smith's tools, Immunity to Poison and Resistance to Fire, and maximum damage to objects. Magic action once per dawn: summon an obedient Earth Elemental for 24 hours. Every 3 days, touch dwarven stonework to cast Teleport without mishap underground. Random properties: 2 minor and 1 major beneficial, 2 minor detrimental.

name: Baba Yaga's Dancing Broom
description: Magic action: the broom becomes an Animated Broom under your control, acting after you; command it mentally within 30 feet and turn it back with a Bonus Action. It regains its Hit Points if reverted before being destroyed.

name: Bead of Refreshment
description: Dissolves in up to a pint of liquid and turns it into fresh, cold drinking water; no effect on magical liquids or poison.

name: Blackrazor
description: A sentient +3 greatsword (Chaotic Neutral) that hungers for souls. Hitting Undead costs you 1d10 Necrotic and heals them. While held: Immunity to Charmed and Frightened, Blindsight 30 feet. Dropping a creature to 0 slays it and devours its soul (only Wish restores it), granting Temporary Hit Points equal to its Hit Point maximum. It can cast Haste on you once per dawn, at its own discretion. Three days without a soul brings a conflict with its wielder.

name: Book of Exalted Deeds
description: Only the attuned can open it; Fiends and Undead who read it take 24d6 Radiant. Attuned: Immunity to Charmed and Frightened and Resistance to Psychic. After 80 hours of study: those become permanent, Wisdom +2 (max 24), spell slots count one level higher, and a halo (Bonus Action) gives Advantage on Persuasion and Disadvantage to attacks from Fiends and Undead in its light. Benefits need a kind act every 10 days and no willing evil. Random properties: 2 minor and 2 major beneficial.

name: Book of Vile Darkness
description: Non-Fiend, non-Undead attuners make a DC 17 Charisma save or become a Larva. After 80 hours of study: raise one ability by 2 (max 24) and lower another by 2, Immunity to Exhaustion, cast Animate Dead, Circle of Death, Dominate Monster and Finger of Death once each per dawn (DC 18), Advantage on lore checks about evil, and Vile Speech (Magic action: 1d12 Psychic to you, 3d6 to non-Fiend, non-Undead creatures within 15 feet). Requires an evil act every 10 days. Random properties: 3 minor and 1 major beneficial, 3 minor and 2 major detrimental.

name: Boots of False Tracks
description: Your tracks can look like those of any Humanoid of your size.

name: Candle of the Deep
description: Keeps burning underwater, giving normal candle light and heat.

name: Cap of Water Breathing
description: Underwater, a Magic action creates an air bubble around your head that lets you breathe until you take off the cap or leave the water.

name: Cast-Off Armor
description: Doff this armor as a Magic action.

name: Cauldron of Rebirth
description: Spellcasting focus and a Scrying component. After a Long Rest, brew a Potion of Healing (greater) that lasts 24 hours. Magic action: grow it to hold a Medium creature; a Humanoid corpse covered in 200 pounds of salt for 8 hours returns as by Raise Dead at the next dawn, once every 7 days.

name: Charlatan's Die
description: You control the number this six-sided die rolls.

name: Cloak of Billowing
description: Bonus Action: the cloak billows dramatically for 1 minute.

name: Cloak of Many Fashions
description: Bonus Action: change the cloak's style, color and apparent quality; it stays a cloak and gains no other cloak's magic.

name: Clockwork Amulet
description: Once per dawn, take a 10 on the d20 of an attack roll instead of rolling.

name: Clothes of Mending
description: This outfit repairs its own daily wear and tear, though not destroyed pieces.

name: Cube of Summoning
description: Magic action once per dawn: wind the crank and a creature appears, from a random Summon spell (Aberration, Beast, Construct, Dragon, Elemental or Fey) cast at level 5 (save DC 17, +9 to hit) without Concentration, with you as caster.

name: Dark Shard Amulet
description: Spellcasting focus for Warlock spells. Once per Long Rest, a Magic action and a DC 10 Arcana check let you cast a Warlock action cantrip you do not know.

name: Demonomicon of Iggwilv
description: Advantage on demon lore and Abyss Survival checks. Magic action once per dawn: trap a Fiend held in Magic Circle in a blank page (DC 20 Charisma save with Disadvantage); trapped Fiends may try to possess you after Long Rests. Magic Circle and Planar Binding against Fiends cast at level 9 with Disadvantage on their saves, and your spell damage against Fiends is maximized. 8 charges (1d8 back at dawn) for Magic Circle, Magic Jar, Planar Ally, Planar Binding, Plane Shift to the Abyss, Summon Fiend and Tasha's Hideous Laughter (DC 20). Random properties: 2 minor beneficial, 1 minor and 1 major detrimental.

name: Dread Helm
description: While worn, your eyes glow red and the rest of your face is hidden in shadow.

name: Driftglobe
description: Within 60 feet, command it to shine as Light or Daylight (Daylight once per dawn). Magic action: it floats up to 5 feet off the ground and follows you within 60 feet until grasped.

name: Ear Horn of Hearing
description: Held to your ear, it suppresses the Deafened condition on you.

name: Efreeti Chain
description: +3 AC, Immunity to Fire damage, you know Primordial, and you can walk on molten rock.

name: Enduring Spellbook
description: The book and its writing cannot be harmed by fire or water and do not age.

name: Enspelled Armor
description: Holds an Abjuration or Illusion spell of level 8 or lower; 6 charges (1d6 back at dawn), 1 charge to cast it. Spell level sets rarity and DC: cantrip or 1 Uncommon (DC 13, +5), 2 Rare (13, +5), 3 Rare (15, +7), 4 Very Rare (15, +7), 5 Very Rare (17, +9), 6 Legendary (17, +9), 7 or 8 Legendary (18, +10).

name: Enspelled Staff
description: Holds a spell of any school, level 8 or lower; 6 charges (1d6 back at dawn), 1 charge to cast it; spending the last charge risks a 1 in 20 chance it becomes a plain Quarterstaff. Rarity and DC follow the spell level as for Enspelled Armor.

name: Enspelled Weapon
description: Holds a Conjuration, Divination, Evocation, Necromancy or Transmutation spell of level 8 or lower; 6 charges (1d6 back at dawn), 1 charge to cast it. Rarity and DC follow the spell level as for Enspelled Armor.

name: Ersatz Eye
description: Replaces a lost eye and sees like a natural one; insert or remove it as a Magic action, and it cannot be taken from you while alive.

name: Executioner's Axe
description: +1 weapon; a hit on a Humanoid deals an extra 2d6 Slashing and gives you that much in Temporary Hit Points.

name: Eye and Hand of Vecna
description: Two artifacts; attuning grafts the eye or hand on permanently (removal kills you) and makes you Neutral Evil. Eye: Truesight 240 feet, 8 charges (1d4 + 4 at dawn) for Clairvoyance, Crown of Madness, Disintegrate, Dominate Monster and Eyebite (DC 18) with a 5 percent chance per casting that Vecna takes your body, and 1 minute of 30-foot X-ray vision as a Magic action. Hand: Strength 20, an extra 2d8 Cold on melee hits, and 8 charges for Finger of Death, Sleep, Slow and Teleport (DC 18), each casting answered by a Suggestion to do evil. Both: Advantage on Initiative, a 7d6 Necrotic touch (DC 18 Constitution) that turns victims to green slime, Immunity to Poison, regenerate 1d10 a turn, and Wish once per 30 days. Each has 1 minor and 1 major beneficial, 1 minor detrimental random property.

name: Hag Eye
description: 3 charges (all back at dawn): spend 1 to cast Darkvision on yourself or See Invisibility. A hag of the coven that made it can see through it while concentrating.

name: Hat of Vermin
description: 3 charges (all back at dawn): Magic action to summon a Bat, Frog or Rat that is not under your control and vanishes after 1 hour.

name: Hat of Wizardry
description: Spellcasting focus for Wizard spells. Once per Long Rest, a Magic action and a DC 10 Arcana check let you cast a Wizard action cantrip you do not know.

name: Heward's Handy Spice Pouch
description: 10 charges (1d6 + 4 back at dawn): Magic action to pull out a pinch of any named nonmagical seasoning.

name: Horn of Silent Alarm
description: 4 charges (1d4 back at dawn): Magic action to blow it so that one chosen creature within 600 feet, and no one else, hears it.

name: Instrument of Illusions
description: While you play it, a Magic action creates harmless, obviously illusory visuals in a 5-foot Emanation (15 feet for a Bard).

name: Instrument of Scribing
description: 3 charges (all back at dawn): while playing, a Magic action writes a six-word magical message (13 words and glowing for a Bard) on a surface within 30 feet, lasting 24 hours or until dispelled.

name: Instrument of the Bards
description: Attuned Bards cast its spells once each per dawn with their own ability and DC; others who play it make a DC 15 Wisdom save or take 2d4 Psychic. All cast Fly, Invisibility, Levitate and Protection from Evil and Good, plus: Doss lute and Fochlucan bandore and Mac-Fuirmidh cittern (Uncommon), Canaith mandolin and Cli lyre (Rare), Anstruth harp (Very Rare), Ollamh harp (Legendary), each with its own spell set.

name: Keoghtom's Ointment
description: A jar of 1d4 + 1 doses. Utilize action: swallow one or apply it to a creature within 5 feet, which regains 2d8 + 2 Hit Points and stops being Poisoned.

name: Lock of Trickery
description: An ordinary-looking lock with one key; checks to pick it have Disadvantage.

name: Lute of Thunderous Thumping
description: A magic Club that deals an extra 2d8 Thunder on a hit. A Bard who sings or hums while attacking can use Charisma instead of Strength for the attack.

name: Mariner's Armor
description: Swim Speed equal to your Speed, and once per dawn, starting your turn underwater at 0 Hit Points restores 1d4 Hit Points.

name: Moon-Touched Sword
category: Weapon (Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword)
description: Unsheathed in darkness, the blade sheds Bright Light 15 feet and Dim Light 15 feet beyond.

name: Moonblade
category: Weapon (Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword)
attunement_note: by a Creature of the Weapon's Choice
description: A sentient elven blade that chooses its bearer; a rejected attuner is cursed with Disadvantage on D20 Tests for 24 hours. For anyone else it is a plain weapon. Its first rune gives +1, and each further rune (typically 1d6 + 1 in all) adds a property: up to +3, up to 3d6 extra Force, Thrown and returning, crits on 19 to 20, a blinding flash (DC 15 Constitution, once per Short Rest), Ring of Spell Storing, or a Shadow servant. It also has a minor property.

name: Mystery Key
description: Has a 5 percent chance to open any lock it is put in, then vanishes.

name: Nature's Mantle
description: Spellcasting focus for Druid and Ranger spells, and in Lightly Obscured areas you can Hide as a Bonus Action even while observed.

name: Orb of Direction
description: Arcane focus; a Magic action tells you which way magnetic north lies, where there is one.

name: Orb of Time
description: Arcane focus; on the Material Plane a Magic action tells you whether it is morning, afternoon, evening or night.

name: Perfume of Bewitching
description: One use. Magic action to apply: for 1 hour, Advantage on Deception and Persuasion checks to influence creatures within 5 feet.

name: Pipe of Smoke Monsters
description: While smoking it, a Magic action puffs out a 1-foot smoke creature that loses its shape in a few seconds.

name: Pole of Angling
description: A Pole that turns into a fishing rod with line and reel, and back, as a Magic action.

name: Pole of Collapsing
description: A Pole that collapses into a 1-foot rod (same weight), and back, as a Magic action.

name: Pot of Awakening
description: A shrub grown in it for 30 days becomes an Awakened Shrub, breaking the pot; it is Friendly and obeys you.

name: Potion of Comprehension
description: Grants the effect of Comprehend Languages for 1 hour.

name: Potion of Fire Breath
description: For up to 1 hour, three times: Bonus Action to breathe fire at a target within 30 feet, DC 13 Dexterity save for 4d6 Fire, half on a success.

name: Potion of Greater Invisibility
description: You are Invisible for 1 hour.

name: Potion of Pugilism
description: For 10 minutes, your Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d6 Force on a hit.

name: Prosthetic Limb
description: Replaces a lost limb and works like the original; attach or detach it as a Magic action, and it cannot be removed against your will while alive.

name: Quaal's Feather Token
description: A single-use token of one type: Anchor (Uncommon, a ship cannot move for 24 hours), Bird (Rare, a non-attacking Roc that carries 500 pounds at 16 mph), Fan (Uncommon, fills one ship's sails for 8 hours), Swan Boat (Rare, a 50-foot self-propelled boat for 24 hours), Tree (Uncommon, a 60-foot oak), or Whip (Rare, a floating whip for 1 hour making +9 Bonus Action attacks for 1d6 + 5 Force).

name: Quiver of Ehlonna
description: Never weighs more than 2 pounds; holds 60 arrows or bolts, 18 javelins, and 6 long items such as bows, staffs or spears, drawn like a normal quiver.

name: Rival Coin
description: 1 charge per dawn: toss it as a Magic action. Heads, a creature within 60 feet makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or takes 2d4 Psychic and has Disadvantage on its next attack (half damage only on a success); tails, you take 1d4 Psychic.

name: Rod of the Pact Keeper
description: +1, +2 or +3 (Uncommon, Rare, Very Rare) to Warlock spell attacks and save DCs, and once per Long Rest regain one spell slot as a Magic action.

name: Rope of Mending
description: 50 feet of rope; a Magic action rejoins all touching cut pieces. Lost sections stay lost.

name: Ruby of the War Mage
description: Pressed onto a Simple or Martial weapon for 10 minutes, it lets the weapon serve as your spellcasting focus; detach it as a Magic action.

name: Saddle of the Cavalier
description: While you ride in it: attacks against your mount have Disadvantage, and you cannot be dismounted against your will unless Incapacitated.

name: Scroll of Protection
description: Protects against one creature type. Magic action to read: for 5 minutes, creatures of that type cannot enter or affect a 5-foot Emanation around you; one can try to break in with a DC 15 Charisma save. Moving onto them ends it.

name: Scroll of Titan Summoning
description: Magic action to read: a titan (Animal Lord, Blob of Annihilation, Colossus, Elemental Cataclysm, Empyrean, Kraken or Tarrasque) appears within 1 mile, Hostile to everyone, until it drops to 0 Hit Points. Fails if there is no room.

name: Shield of Expression
description: Bonus Action: change the expression of the face on the shield.

name: Silvered Weapon
description: Critical Hits against shape-shifted creatures deal one extra damage die.

name: Smoldering Armor
description: Harmless, odorless smoke rises from the armor while worn.

name: Spirit Board
description: 3 charges (1 back at dawn): spend 1 minute touching the planchette to cast Augury (1 charge) or Commune (3 charges).

name: Staff of Adornment
description: Up to three Tiny objects of 1 pound or less float above its tip and spin at your will while you hold it.

name: Staff of Birdcalls
description: 10 charges (1d6 + 4 at dawn): a Magic action makes one of ten bird calls audible to 120 feet. Spending the last charge gives a 1 in 20 chance it bursts into feathers.

name: Staff of Flowers
description: 10 charges (1d6 + 4 at dawn): a Magic action sprouts a harmless flower within 5 feet. Spending the last charge gives a 1 in 20 chance it becomes petals.

name: Staff of the Adder
description: Bonus Action: the head becomes a live snake for 1 minute; one Attack-action attack uses it (Proficiency Bonus + WIS, reach 5 feet) for 1d6 Piercing plus 3d6 Poison. The head has AC 15 and 20 Hit Points; if it drops to 0 the staff is destroyed.

name: Sword of Answering
description: +3 longsword; a Reaction lets you attack with Advantage a creature in reach that damages you, ignoring its Resistance and Immunity.

name: Sword of Kas
description: A sentient +3 longsword (Chaotic Evil) that crits on 19 to 20, deals an extra 2d10 Slashing to Undead, and wants Vecna's ruin. Unblooded within a minute of drawing, it forces a DC 15 Charisma save: 3d6 Psychic, or be dominated until it tastes blood. Casts Call Lightning, Divine Word and Finger of Death once each per dawn (DC 18). Add 1d10 to Initiative, shift its attack bonus to AC, and Resistance to Necrotic. Random properties: 1 minor and 1 major beneficial, 1 minor and 1 major detrimental.

name: Sword of Vengeance
category: Weapon (Glaive, Greatsword, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Shortsword)
description: +1 weapon carrying a curse: you will not part with it, other weapons attack with Disadvantage, and when damaged in combat you make a DC 15 Wisdom save or must fight that attacker. Banishment on the sword frees the spirit, leaving a plain +1 weapon.

name: Sylvan Talon
category: Weapon (Dagger, Rapier, Scimitar, Shortsword, Sickle, or Spear)
description: You understand the nonwritten communication of Fey and they understand yours; once per dawn, cast Message through it.

name: Talking Doll
description: During a Short Rest within 5 feet, teach it up to six phrases of six words, each tied to a trigger within 5 feet.

name: Tankard of Sobriety
description: Nonmagical alcohol drunk from it does not intoxicate you; no effect on magical liquids or poison.

name: Tentacle Rod
description: Magic action: three tentacles attack creatures within 15 feet at +9, 1d6 Psychic each. All three on one target forces a DC 15 Dexterity save or Restrained, taking 3d6 Psychic each turn (repeats the save each turn).

name: Tome of the Stilled Tongue
description: A spellbook and arcane focus; once per dawn, cast a spell written in it as a Bonus Action with no slot, Verbal or Somatic components. Removing the tongue erases it. Vecna watches its users.

name: Veteran's Cane
description: Bonus Action while held: turn it into a plain Longsword or back into a cane.

name: Walloping Ammunition
description: A creature hit makes a DC 10 Strength save or is knocked Prone.

name: Wand of Conducting
description: 3 charges (all at dawn): a Magic action plays orchestral music audible to 120 feet while you wave it. Spending the last charge gives a 1 in 20 chance it crumbles.

name: Wand of Orcus
description: Non-Orcus attuners make a DC 17 Constitution save: 10d6 Necrotic on a success, death (and a Zombie, if Humanoid) on a failure. A sentient +3 Mace dealing an extra 2d12 Necrotic, +3 AC while held, destroys Holy Water within 10 feet, 7 charges (1d4 + 3 at dawn) for Animate Dead, Blight, Circle of Death, Finger of Death, Power Word Kill and Speak with Dead (DC 18), and once per dawn calls 15 Skeletons and 15 Zombies until dawn. Random properties: 2 minor and 1 major beneficial, 2 minor and 1 major detrimental.

name: Wand of Pyrotechnics
description: 7 charges (1d6 + 1 at dawn): a Magic action makes a harmless burst of colored light within 120 feet, heard to 300 feet. Spending the last charge gives a 1 in 20 chance it is destroyed.

name: Wave
description: A sentient +3 trident (Neutral) devoted to sea gods; a natural 20 deals an extra 21 Necrotic. While held: Advantage on Initiative and an air bubble underwater. 3 charges (1d3 at dawn) for Dominate Beast (DC 20) on swimming Beasts, and level 9 Globe of Invulnerability once per dawn.

name: Whelm
attunement_note: by a Dwarf or a Creature Attuned to a Belt of Dwarvenkind
description: A sentient +3 warhammer (Lawful Neutral) for dwarves; Thrown (60/180) and returning, ranged hits add 1d8 Force (4d8 against Constructs, Elementals and Giants). Once per dawn, a Magic action shock wave Stuns chosen creatures on the ground within 60 feet (DC 20 Constitution, repeats each turn). Senses secret doors within 30 feet and casts Detect Evil and Good or Locate Object once per dawn.

name: Wraps of Unarmed Power
description: +1, +2 or +3 (Uncommon, Rare, Very Rare) to Unarmed Strike attack and damage, which can deal Force instead of their normal type.

name: Boots of the Winding Path
description: Bonus Action: teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that you occupied earlier this turn.

name: Dazzling Weapon
description: +1 to attack and damage. Bonus Action to shed Bright Light 30 feet and Dim Light 30 more, or to douse it. 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn): Reaction right after you're hit by an attack roll, spend 1 so the attacker makes a DC 15 Con save or is Blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Helm of Awareness
description: Advantage on Initiative rolls while worn.

name: Manifold Tool
description: Magic action: becomes any type of Artisan's Tools, and you are proficient with it in any form.

name: Mind Sharpener
description: 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn). When you fail a Concentration save, Reaction and 1 charge to succeed instead.

name: Repeating Shot
category: Weapon (Any Simple or Martial with Ammunition)
description: +1 to ranged attack and damage rolls, ignores Loading, and creates a piece of magic ammunition when fired empty that vanishes after the shot.

name: Repulsion Shield
description: +1 AC beyond the shield. 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn): Reaction when a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, spend 1 to push it 15 feet away.

name: Returning Weapon
category: Weapon (Any Simple or Martial with Thrown)
description: +1 to attack and damage; returns to your hand right after a ranged attack.

name: Spell-Refueling Ring
description: Bonus Action: recover one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower. Once per dawn.

name: Reliquary of Dawn
description: A talisman holding a claw, scale or fang shed by Eirdu, the sun incarnation of Lorwyn. While you wear it, you are immune to the effects of Eventide.

name: Reliquary of Twilight
description: A talisman holding a claw, scale or fang shed by Isilu, the moon incarnation of Shadowmoor. While you wear it, you are immune to the effects of Morningtide.

name: Alarm Pylon
description: A 5-foot rune-etched stone post. Touch it as a Magic action to arm it with one trigger: a spell of a named school is cast, a creature takes 5 or more damage, or an object takes 10 or more damage. While armed, the trigger occurring within 300 feet sets off a 10-second alarm audible 300 feet away. Disarm it with a Magic action.

name: Silencing Satchel
description: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. As a Magic action, spend 1 charge and pull the drawstring: one creature you can see within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Charisma save or is cursed for 1 minute, its mouth sealed. It can't cast Verbal-component spells, drink potions, eat, or drink, and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

name: Sync Ring
description: On attuning, pick a blank book you are touching. Anything you then write with the ringed hand is copied into that book; magical writing copies as nonmagical text. Attunement ends if the book runs out of pages or spends more than 24 hours on another plane from you.

name: Unraveling Cloak
description: Take a Magic action to unbutton the hood: the cloak unravels behind you, leaving a continuous thread that others notice only with a Search action and a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check. It stops after 100 miles or when you rebutton it (Magic action). Teleporting destroys the thread laid so far.

name: Wand of Misdirection
description: 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. While holding it, spend 1 charge to cast Mislead.

name: Climber's Ammunition
description: When this ammunition hits a solid surface it sticks there and trails a magic rope that lasts 1 hour or until dismissed and holds up to 500 pounds. Afterward the ammunition is nonmagical. If it hits a creature it breaks and deals no damage.

name: Goggles of Foe-Finding
description: While you wear these goggles, your ranged weapon attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

name: Stormwalker's Cloak
description: You have Resistance to Lightning and Thunder damage. The cloak has 3 charges, regaining all at dawn; spend 1 to cast Hellish Rebuke (save DC 13) dealing Lightning or Thunder damage instead of Fire.

name: Amulet of Retributive Healing
description: 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. When you restore Hit Points to another creature, you can spend 1 charge to regain the same number of Hit Points yourself.

name: Eternal Chalk
description: This chalk never breaks or wears down. You choose the color of its marks and whether they glow faintly, and no one but you can erase them for 7 days.

name: Salubrious Armor
description: You gain +1 to AC while wearing it. Whenever you regain Hit Points, it tints red and the bonus becomes +2 until the end of your next turn.

name: Frog Prince Statuette
description: Kiss it and speak the command word to cast Mandy's Feral Follower, turning it into a Commoner who remembers every previous transformation. Once per dawn.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Leonora's Throne of Indolence
description: A 100-pound flying armchair: sit and speak a command word (Magic action) to fly 50 feet with hover, carrying up to 400 pounds. A second command word casts Unseen Servant (it can also trumpet your arrival). Once per dawn, a third conjures up to 10 pounds of food and four bottles of wine that only you can enjoy.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Memento Mori
description: A sealed letter describing how its reader will die, never when. After reading it you have Advantage on Death Saves and die only after five failures, but if you drop to 0 HP in the described moment you die outright. It becomes an ordinary letter once read, and its effect ends only if you die and are revived.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Portable Cannonballs
description: Twenty inch-wide iron balls that pour out as Ball Bearings. As a Bonus Action command any of them to grow into 10-pound cannonballs; rolling ones force a DC 13 Dex save for 2d10 Bludgeoning and Prone (Large or smaller). Fired as a sling or firearm bullet and expanded mid-flight (Bonus Action), a hit deals 2d12 + the attack's ability modifier Bludgeoning.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Ring of Barrels
description: 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. As a Magic action spend 1-3 to summon that many empty Barrels within 5 feet (AC 15, 20 HP, Half Cover, can be rolled). A Medium or smaller creature in a Barrel's space makes a DC 13 Dex save (with Advantage unless its Speed is 0) or is trapped: Restrained if Medium, Total Cover if smaller; escaping takes an action and a DC 20 Athletics check.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack

name: Bag of Cheer
description: A 30-pound velvet sack of presents. As a Magic action pull out a gift (worth up to 100 GP) tailored to the recipient, chosen by the GM or rolled (weapon or Shield, gold, art, fine clothes, tool or instrument, Potion of Healing, gems, exotic food, book, toy or gaming set). Three per dawn; more are empty boxes.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Gambler's Coin
description: 3 charges, regaining all at dawn. Spend 1 to replace a D20 Test roll with a coin flip: heads counts as 20 (no crit or other natural-20 effects), tails as 1.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Leaden Manacles
description: A bound creature that casts a spell or takes a Magic action makes a DC 20 check with its spellcasting ability; on a failure the attempt fails, the resources and action are wasted, and it takes 4d6 Fire.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Nolzur's Painted World
description: A Medium or Large painting that is a portal to a demiplane its painter designed; creatures that fit can step through, returning by a misty arch that vanishes if the painting's face is covered. Things taken out dissolve into smoke, and time inside runs at half speed.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Reaper's Ammunition
description: A creature that takes damage from this ammunition dies. The ammunition then becomes nonmagical.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Soul Figurine
description: When you drop to 0 HP, your HP becomes 2d10 + 10 instead and the figurine turns sorrowful and nonmagical.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Weapon Charm, Arrowhead
description: Attach or remove as a Magic action (one charm per weapon; the weapon becomes magic and needs attunement). Ranged attacks with the weapon ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Weapon Charm, Blade
description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. The weapon gets +1 (Uncommon), +2 (Rare), or +3 (Very Rare) to attack and damage; it doesn't stack with an existing bonus.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Weapon Charm, Die
description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. On a crit with the weapon, damage dice that roll their maximum add another die, up to 5 extra.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Weapon Charm, Flame
description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. The weapon deals Fire and sets what it hits Burning for 1 minute; each further hit steps the burn die up (to 1d12).
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Weapon Charm, Hook
description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. As a Bonus Action teleport the weapon to your hand from anywhere on your plane.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Weapon Charm, Lance
description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. Once per turn before a melee attack with it against a creature you can see, lunge up to 15 feet toward it without provoking (even through the air, falling after).
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Weapon Charm, Lightning Bolt
description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. The weapon deals Lightning and +1d6 Lightning on a hit.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Weapon Charm, Quiver
description: Attach or remove as a Magic action. The weapon ignores Loading, and carried ammunition teleports into it as needed.
book: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2

name: Airbag Shield
description: Cast Airbag from the shield on yourself once per dawn; touching it and expending a level 1+ slot as a Magic action restores the use.

name: Brewer's Torch
description: A First Age torch fueled by potions: pour one in as a Magic action, then activate as a Magic action to consume it. Bubble Blowtorch: lift a loose object of 100 pounds or less 10 feet for 1 minute, movable as if 5 pounds. Butterfly Blowtorch: end one Charmed, Frightened, or Pacified effect on a creature within 5 feet, or Mend an object. Water Jet Blowtorch: a creature within 15 feet makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, 2d4 Slashing or half, or cut a 5-foot line through up to 1 foot of metal, stone, or wood.

name: Demon Rattle
description: +1 to saves against Demon effects. As a Magic action shake it; Demons in a 15-foot Emanation that hear it make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are Pacified while you keep shaking it each turn (ends if damaged or out of earshot). Once per dawn.

name: Healing Patches
description: Attach up to three over an hour; rip one off as a Bonus Action (or an ally does as a Magic action if you are Unconscious) to regain Hit Points: Healing Patch (Common) 1d8 + 3, 2nd Class (Uncommon) 2d8 + 6, 1st Class (Rare) 4d8 + 12.

name: Press Pass
description: As a Magic action press it to wood, plaster, or stone up to 5 feet thick to open a 3-by-7-foot doorway for 10 minutes (close it early as a Magic action). Once per dawn.

name: Soda (Cursed)
description: Drinking it curses you until a level 5+ Remove Curse or eating a pound of Black Cinnamon and bathing in still water. Each day one random spell slot or attuned item spell is expended; with none, take 2d10 Necrotic.

name: Welders Shawl
description: +3 to Intelligence (Mechanics) checks, and vehicles you repair regain Hit Points equal to your check -5 (minimum 3) instead of -10.

name: Whiskered Nakurina
description: As a Magic action, play to a Demon that can hear it and make a Charisma (Performance) check; it makes a Wisdom save against the result (maximum 20) or drops an item, moves its Speed in your chosen direction, or attacks a creature within 5 feet of your choice. If it succeeds, you take 2d4 Psychic.

name: Sacrificial Brand
description: A carving applied over an hour; removed only by burning (Scarified can't be removed). During the Blood Moon, Evil creatures in Luyarnha have Advantage to track you. Drawn (Common): that only. Tattooed (Uncommon): within 120 feet they know your location and get +1 to attack and damage against you. Scarified (Rare): +3 against you and -3 against others, but you bleed when hostile monsters within 300 feet know where you are and can't be surprised during the Blood Moon.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Meat Hookshot
description: Bonus Action to transform. Untransformed: a Finesse Sickle and one-handed Blunderbuss; after attacking with the Sickle, fire the Blunderbuss as a Bonus Action. Transformed: a two-handed Blunderbuss with a Battleaxe blade and Hookshot (Utilize action, ranged attack within 30 feet for 1d4 + Dex Slashing, pulling a creature your size or smaller to you on a failed DC 13 Strength save, or you to a larger one).
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Dream Executioner
description: +1 weapon. Untransformed: Scythe and lantern that harvests the soul of a CR or level 1+ creature dying within 15 feet (one at a time; it can't be raised while held). Transformed: Maul whose hit can destroy the held soul for a 15-foot ghostflame burst, DC 14 Dexterity save, 2d8 Radiant plus 2d8 Necrotic or half (Undead fail).
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Ravenous Gazer
description: +1 glaive you are proficient with. Transformed (costing 1d4 unpreventable Necrotic on transforming and each turn), it is a Spellcasting Focus granting +2 to spell attacks, +1 spell save DC, and Truesight 30 feet.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Unstable Crumbler
description: Double damage to structures and reduce Fire damage by your Constitution modifier. Transforming to Maul can blast you 30 feet; transforming to Cannon can reload it and push you back 30 feet on your next ranged hit. Cannon: on a 15+ the ball explodes as an Explosive Cannonball. Maul: on an 18+ the head detonates as Fireball (DC 15) on the target, which you can avoid with a successful save.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Galvanized Claw
description: Resistance to Lightning and Thunder. Untransformed gauntlet: Advantage on Initiative, +1d6 Lightning on melee hits while you have Temporary Hit Points, and 3 charges to turn Lightning or Thunder damage into Temporary Hit Points. Transformed claw: Unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 Slashing (+1, Str or Dex), a Bonus Action claw attack after the Attack action, and +1d8 Lightning while you have Temporary Hit Points; too clumsy for triggers or lockpicks.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Orphan's Cradle
description: +1 Reach morningstar. Untransformed: Humanoids within 10 feet have Advantage against Charmed and Frightened; Cleansing Miasma (Magic action, 1d12 Temporary Hit Points and end Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned, once per hour per creature); hits poison Beasts and Undead (DC 16 Constitution). Transformed: +2d6 Fire, Fanned Flames (20-foot Cone, DC 16 Dexterity, 3d6 Fire plus 3d6 Poison), and Withering Flames (Beast or Undead gains a Vulnerability on a failed DC 16 Constitution save).
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Revelations
attunement_note: by a Creature with a Strength of 15 or Higher
description: +1 weapon studded with eyes: you can't be surprised, unseen attackers gain no Advantage, and you are immune to Blinded. Cleaver: a hit curses the target for an hour (+1 damage, crits on 19 to 20, Advantage to track it). Whip: 1d6 Slashing, Versatile (1d8), once per turn Strength save or 1d6 Slashing and Prone. Curse: your sight secretly worsens until you go blind.
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Shard of Moonlight
description: Sentient +3 blade dealing +1d6 Radiant, with proficiency, Advantage on Wisdom saves (except against Madness), and use as a Spellcasting Focus.
