Longsword: once per turn make a second attack, and absorb spells targeting you as a Reaction for up to 10 charges. Greatsword (under moonlight, 1 minute): +2d6 Radiant and spend charges for Revealing Glow (+1d12 Radiant and the target glows), Transient Moonlight (60-foot Line, DC 18 Constitution, 2d12 Radiant), or Lunar Explosion (30-foot burst, DC 18 Dexterity, 3d12 Radiant and Prone).
book: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack

name: Battle Rod
description: Held in two hands, cast cantrips at up to twice their range; beyond normal range, attack rolls have Disadvantage and targets have Advantage on saves.

name: Charlatan's Gloves
description: As a Magic action, create a silent palm-sized illusory image for 1 minute (Concentration). A Study action and Investigation check against your Deception reveals it.

name: Drybrooch
description: As a Magic action, raise or dismiss a small overhead dome that sheds rain, snow, and similar nuisances (not hazards or attacks).

name: Duster
description: As a Magic action, instantly clean dirt and grime from up to 1 cubic foot within 10 feet.

name: Integrated Tool
description: A tool (Artisan's Tool, Forgery, Herbalism, or Poisoner's Kit, Thieves' Tools, or Musical Instrument) built into a warforged's body over 1 hour; it can't be removed against your will and still needs a free hand. One at a time; warforged only.

name: Lamplighter
description: As a Magic action, light or snuff a candle, torch, small campfire, or similar flame within 10 feet.

name: Spark
description: As a Bonus Action, touch a candle, torch, small campfire, or similar object to ignite it.

name: Talking Wand
description: While held, your voice and other sounds you make are three times as loud.

name: Thurimbar Rod
description: A Musical Instrument: as a Magic action, perfectly mimic the sound of any instrument you're proficient with (Charisma check sets quality); if proficient with the rod itself, play unearthly music.

name: War Staff
description: Held in both hands, it's an Arcane Focus and your cantrips reach up to four times their range; beyond twice normal range, attack rolls have Disadvantage and targets have Advantage on saves.

name: Breastplate of Kamvuul Norek
description: +2 AC, Critical Hits against you become normal hits, and Advantage on saves against spells and magical effects. When you succeed on a save against an Aberration's Mind Blast, you're unaffected and the blast reflects back at the Aberration.

name: Ghaal'duur, the Mighty Dirge
description: +4 Charisma (max 24); 2 minor beneficial and 1 minor detrimental property (goblinoids ignore it). As a two-handed focus, Bard spells get doubled duration (max 24 hours) and range, and cast one slot level higher. Once per Short or Long Rest as a Magic action, sound it: for 10 minutes allies within 600 feet add 1d4 (2d4 goblinoids) to attacks and saves, and enemies failing a Charisma save subtract 1d4 (2d4 goblinoids).

name: Keeper's Fang
description: +1 to attack and damage. A creature it reduces to 0 HP is slain and its soul taken; only Wish can restore it.

name: Shaarat'doovol, the Blade of Truth
description: Sentient. +3 to attack and damage, and +2d10 Radiant against Aberrations. If it favors you, it grants Truesight 90 feet, immunity to Charmed and Frightened, and Resistance to Psychic damage.

name: Uul'kur (Dream Key)
description: Sleeping with it, you dream lucidly and remember your dreams. If you know its workings, as a Magic action bind it to your dreams until dawn; anyone sleeping with it shares your dream.

name: Vola'khesh
description: Linked stones (up to ten). As a Bonus Action, whisper a message heard by everyone within 120 feet wearing a linked stone; blocked by silence, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, or 3 feet of wood.

name: Channeling Wand
attunement_note: by a creature with a specific dragonmark
description: 7 charges (regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn; 1 in 20 to crumble when emptied). Cast a Spells of the Mark spell for charges equal to its level. Extra charges: 2 to cast as a Bonus Action, 1 to double duration (max 24 hours), 1 to double range (Touch becomes 30 feet).

name: Dragonmark Channel
attunement_note: by a creature with a specific dragonmark
description: Once per Long Rest, cast any level 1 spell on your Spells of the Mark list, using your Dragonmark feat's ability.

name: Dragonmark Reservoir
attunement_note: by a creature with a specific dragonmark
description: 7 charges (regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn). Cast a Spells of the Mark spell at level 1 or 2 for charges equal to its level.

name: Ghallanda Cauldron
attunement_note: by a creature with the Mark of Hospitality
description: Heats, chills, and flavors food, cutting cooking time by 90 percent, and gives Advantage on checks with Cook's Utensils.

name: Helm of the Sentinel
attunement_note: by a creature with the Mark of Sentinel
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. Magic action, 1 charge: a ward that auto-Counterspells (Wisdom) the next hostile spell targeting you within 60 feet. Magic action, 1 charge: Protection from Energy on yourself. Bonus Action, 1 charge: Shield of Faith on yourself.

name: Houseward
description: A creature with the Mark of Warding touching it for 10 minutes casts Guards and Wards for 24 days, covering 2,500 (Uncommon), 5,000 (Rare), or 10,000 (Legendary) square feet. Once per dawn; ends if moved or reused.

name: Manor Key
description: Usable only with the Mark of Hospitality. Once per dawn as a Magic action, cast Mordenkainen's Magnificent Mansion without components; it lasts 24 hours or until you lock it.

name: Prospector's Wand
attunement_note: by a creature with the Mark of Finding
description: 5 charges (regains 1d4 + 1 at dawn; 1 in 20 to crumble when emptied). Locate Creature (2), Locate Object (1), or Locate Animals or Plants (1), which can also find a named mineral at a minimum quantity.

name: Rod of Wild Dominion
attunement_note: by a creature with the Mark of Handling
description: Advantage on Animal Handling and Survival checks. Cast Speak with Animals at will, and Dominate Beast (up to 1 hour, Wisdom) once per dawn.

name: Aereni Mask
attunement_note: by a bearer the noble line's spirits judge worthy
description: Holds two skills; add 1d4 to ability checks with either.

name: Bane Weapon
description: +1 to attack and damage. After a Long Rest choose Aberration, Beast, Celestial, Dragon, Fiend, Giant, or Undead. 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn): spend 1 on a hit against that type for +2d6 damage.

name: Final Messenger
description: A Tiny winged homunculus (AC 20, 6 HP, fly 60) a warforged can integrate as a Magic action. Holds a destination, a target, one image, and a 25-word message; release it as a Bonus Action. If you drop to 0 HP it flies off with the last thing you saw. Warforged only.

name: Gloves of Storing
description: Each glove stores one held object up to 20 pounds; a Bonus Action stores or summons it to your empty hand. A torn glove scatters its contents; placing them in a Bag of Holding or similar destroys both and opens a gate to the Astral Plane.

name: Quiver of Energy
description: After a Long Rest choose Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison; the first hit each turn with ammunition from it deals +1d6 of that type.

name: Resistance Breaker
description: 5 charges (regains 1d4 + 1 at dawn). On a hit, spend 1 to negate all the target's damage Resistances until the end of your next turn.

name: Silent Weapon
description: +1 to attack and damage. Missing a creature you're hidden from doesn't reveal your position.

name: Soarsled
description: A 5-foot crystal disk. In a Syranian manifest zone, activate it as a Magic action to hover; move it 30 feet per turn (plus 60 feet with a DC 12 Acrobatics check as a Magic action), carrying up to 400 pounds. Elsewhere it works once for 10 minutes, then needs 8 hours in a Syranian zone.

name: Tools of the Master
attunement_note: by a character proficient with the tool
description: An Artisan's Tool usable as a Spellcasting Focus, adding its bonus to spell attack rolls and to ability checks made with it.

name: Crawling Gauntlet
description: Unarmed Strikes can deal 1d6 + Strength Slashing, and you can cast Mage Hand as a Magic action. Symbiotic Nature: once attuned, it can't be removed without Remove Curse or similar magic.

name: Coat of Many Eyes
description: Darkvision 120 feet and Advantage on sight-based Perception. Evolving through service to Belashyrra: Rare adds +1 AC and seeing Invisible within 120 feet; Very Rare also casts Arcane Eye once per Long Rest. Symbiotic Nature: once attuned, it can't be removed without Remove Curse or similar magic.

name: Hungry Weapon
description: Others have Disadvantage wielding it and take 1d4 Piercing each turn if you're attuned. Bond to it as a Bonus Action: it can't leave your grip, and on a hit you can spend a Hit Die to deal extra Necrotic equal to the roll + Constitution and regain that many HP.

name: Shadow Sibling
description: As a Bonus Action, wrap yourself in shadow: Disadvantage on Perception to see you and Advantage on Stealth to Hide. When hit, use your Reaction and a Hit Die to add the roll to your AC until the end of your next turn. Symbiotic Nature: once attuned, it can't be removed without Remove Curse or similar magic.

name: Spellburrow
description: Knows a Sorcerer or Warlock cantrip you can cast, plus a level 1 and level 2 spell from the same list that a spellcaster can cast as always-prepared spells (Intelligence or another spellcasting ability). Symbiotic Nature: once attuned, it can't be removed without Remove Curse or similar magic.

name: Throwing Scarab
description: For each attack in the Attack action, grow a chitin shard (magic simple weapon, Finesse, Light, Thrown 20/60) dealing 1d4 Piercing plus 1d4 Acid; it dissolves after the attack. Symbiotic Nature: once attuned, it can't be removed without Remove Curse or similar magic.

name: Tongueworm
description: As a Bonus Action, an Unarmed Strike with the worm (Strength or Dexterity) for 1d4 + modifier Piercing; DC 13 Constitution save or Poisoned until the start of your next turn. Symbiotic Nature: once attuned, it can't be removed without Remove Curse or similar magic.

name: Wandering Eye
description: Stays alert while you sleep (passive Perception, waking you on danger); stretches 18 inches to peer around cover (AC 20, 6 HP); add 1d4 to sight-based Perception and Investigation checks. Symbiotic Nature: once attuned, it can't be removed without Remove Curse or similar magic.

name: Beggar's Wisdom
description: As a Magic action, ask for help with a task; the book opens to an apt proverb and you add 1d4 to your next ability check within 1 minute. Once per dawn across all copies.

name: Daff's Wonderful Draught
description: Drink or administer within 5 feet as a Bonus Action, then roll 1d6: 1 to 3 regain 4d4 + 4 HP; 4 Detect Thoughts (DC 13) for 1 minute; 5 Haste for 1 minute; 6 DC 13 Wisdom save or Tasha's Hideous Laughter for 1 minute.

name: Dry Spell
description: Cast Control Water (DC 15) without materials as a Magic action; water it manipulates is destroyed when the spell ends. The scroll crumbles after a successful casting.

name: Duelist's Scorecard
description: Write up to five names; it ranks them by duels won in the past year. When full, it erases itself after 1 week.

name: Flashdraw Wand
description: You can't be Surprised. When you roll Initiative you can draw it for free, add 1d4 to Initiative, and deal 1 Lightning to every creature within 5 feet.

name: Jury's Squeaky Wheel
description: Unique wagon-wheel shield. As a Bonus Action, give Temporary Hit Points equal to your level to the humanoid within 60 feet you can see with the fewest Hit Points.

name: Lightning Runner
description: A 10-by-10-foot levitating platform (up to 2,000 pounds) that rides lightning rail conductor stones. As a Magic action, expend a slot (or have the Mark of Passage) to send it 30 feet per round forward or back for 1 hour or until stopped.

name: Misthaven Miscellany
description: Unique pouch. Draw a random trinket; it vanishes when you draw another.

name: Quickstone Boomstick
description: When you cast a level 1+ spell through it, you can release a burst: every creature within 5 feet, including you, makes a Constitution save or takes 1d4 Thunder per spell level and is Deafened until the end of its next turn.

name: Sandstorm Staff
description: A magic Quarterstaff with 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn). Spend 1 when casting through it for +1 to that spell's attack rolls, creating a wandering 5-foot dust vortex; creatures starting their turn within 5 feet of a vortex make a Constitution save or take 1d4 Bludgeoning and are Blinded until the end of their turn.

name: Sarkaas' Gladrags
description: Unique cloak. As a Bonus Action, turn your outfit into fine clothing suited to the culture of a creature you can see.

name: Scale of Kethelrax
description: A Spellcasting Focus. Cast Fire Bolt as a Magic action (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma), and its hits can deal Fire instead of Piercing.

name: Shock and Ore
description: Unique pair attuned as one. Wielding both: they're Light, +1 to attack and damage, 3 shared charges (regain 1d3 at dawn). Shock: on a hit, a Bonus Action and 1 charge for +2d8 Lightning and no Reactions until its next turn. Ore: on a hit, 1 charge to cast Earth Tremor as a Reaction centered on the target.

name: Stonebane Weapon
description: Byeshk weapon that ignores Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from stone creatures, stone-skinned creatures, and Petrified creatures. Against Aberrations it deals +1d6 and stops their healing until your next turn.

name: Three-Faced Coin
description: Once per dawn, flip it and choose which of its three faces (Kol Korran, Onatar, or the Keeper) lands up. Learning it takes a Short Rest of study.

name: Thunder Coach
attunement_note: by a creature with the Mark of Passage
description: A 40-foot Orien cargo coach. With an attuned, concentrating marked driver, four beasts pull it at 10 mph (15 on an Orien trade road). It holds a 3-crew cabin, a 20-by-15-by-50-foot extradimensional hold behind an Arcane Locked gate, and a normal side compartment.

name: Brand of Tyranny
description: +1 to spell attack rolls and save DCs. As a Magic action, touch a creature: DC 15 Charisma save or branded until dawn, subtracting 1d4 from attack rolls and saves against Frightened (Remove Curse or Greater Restoration ends it).

name: Demonglass Weapon
description: +1 to attack and damage. On a Critical Hit, the target is Frightened of you until the end of its next turn and you have Advantage on saves until the end of yours.

name: Demonglass Orb
description: An Orb focus. When you cast a Divination spell through it, take 1 to 4 d6 unreducible Necrotic to reduce one target's save by 1 per die.

name: Kharash's Promise
description: Demonglass warhorn: +3 to Bard spell attack rolls and save DCs; 2 minor and 1 major beneficial, 2 minor detrimental properties. You can't be Charmed or Frightened, and those who try take 4d10 Psychic. Heard 1 mile away. Once per 13 days, blow it to doom a creature (DC 20 Charisma): its HP maximum drops by 1 each turn until death, your death, leaving your plane, or Wish; it can teleport next to you as a Bonus Action.

name: Ink's Aide
description: Unique ear-jelly. 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn): as a Magic action cast Enhance Ability (2) or Comprehend Languages (1), save DC 15. Symbiotic Nature: can't be removed or unattuned voluntarily; a spell that ends a curse detaches it.

name: Living Stoneskin
description: +1 AC and Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing; taking 20+ such damage from one roll Petrifies you until the end of your next turn. After each Long Rest, feed it half your remaining Hit Dice or gain 1 Exhaustion level. Symbiotic Nature: can't be removed or unattuned voluntarily; a spell that ends a curse detaches it.

name: Orlassk's Reach
description: The daelkyr Orlassk's stone arm: 2 minor and 1 major beneficial, 2 minor and 1 major detrimental properties. Speak with Aberrations; once per dawn cast Dominate Monster on an Aberration (DC 18); creatures you touch suffer Flesh to Stone (DC 18, no concentration, can't be ended); question stones in a 30-foot Emanation as a Magic action. Only Wish ends the attunement.

name: Quickstone Whisperer
description: Marble torc. As a Magic action, shift a 5-foot cube of quickstone between soft and wet forms or fix it permanently. Cast Mold Earth at will, and Meld into Stone once per dusk. Symbiotic Nature: can't be removed or unattuned voluntarily; a spell that ends a curse detaches it.

name: Barghest Collar
description: As a Bonus Action, take a Small goblin form of your design, losing Quadruped and Bite, for up to 4 hours in 1-minute blocks; it regains 2 hours per 12 hours unused.

name: Cazhaak Eyeblinders
description: See normally while blindfolded and you can't be Blinded by magic, but Petrifying Gaze is unusable. You can seal it in place, keyed to a creature's command word, until spoken, 1 mile apart, or that creature dies.

name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Byeshk Worg Pack
description: Four figurines; as a Magic action throw one within 60 feet to become a friendly, obedient Worg for 1 hour (immune to Psychic, Charmed, and Frightened; Bite +2d6 against Aberrations). Each is unusable for 7 days after reverting.

name: Gorgon Hide Mail
description: Advantage on saves against magical effects that would Restrain or Petrify you.

name: Grist Cakes
description: Troll-meat rations (up to 10). Eating one (Magic action) restores 1 HP and feeds you for a day; the pack regrows 1d6 per day while one remains. Fire or Acid damage to you spoils 1d4 permanently.

name: Lharvion Lens
description: Once per 7 days, activate for 1 minute; creatures viewed through it show ghostly images of every magical shape they've taken in 24 hours (innate, Illusion, or Transmutation).

name: Lustrous Harpy Feather
description: Once, choose to have Advantage on a Persuasion check; the feather then becomes nonmagical.

name: Mask of the Wielder
description: Wield a melee weapon in your mouth if it isn't Heavy, Two-Handed, or Reach (Versatile only one-handed). Made for worgs.

name: Minotaur's Map
description: In its city, speak the command word to add twice your Proficiency Bonus to Survival checks to navigate or track for 1 hour; then it crumbles.

name: Ogre Tines
description: Finger-like iron nails; Medium or larger creatures don't have Disadvantage on Sleight of Hand checks from size while using them.

name: Oni Braid
description: Speak its command word to become exactly 5 feet 10 inches tall and Medium; speak again to revert.

name: Trapper's Teeth
description: +1 to attack and damage. 4 charges (all regained at dawn): on a hit spend 1 to clamp spectral teeth, reducing the target's Speed to 0 (DC 13 Strength save ends at the end of each of its turns).

name: Trollgut Rope
description: 50 feet, holds 3,000 pounds. As a Magic action, rejoin cut ends from the same coil. Fire or Acid damage makes it nonmagical.

name: Ceratopsian Plate
description: +1 or +2 armor. After moving 20 feet straight to end next to a creature, a Bonus Action strike deals Bludgeoning and Piercing damage each equal to your Proficiency Bonus, then a contested Strength check knocks it Prone if you win.

name: Raptor Feather Leathers
description: +1 or +2 armor. Resistance to falling damage, and use your Reaction to become immune to it until the end of your turn.

name: Dead Deity Robes
description: An extra spell slot of your highest level, restored on a Long Rest. Without armor, base AC is 13 + Dexterity.

name: Automimicry Cape
description: As a Bonus Action, Advantage on Intimidation checks this turn against creatures with Intelligence 5 or lower.

name: Pterosaur Wingbow
description: +2 bow. As a Bonus Action, unfurl it into a wing: descend safely from any height, gliding 2 feet horizontally per foot of descent without using movement.

name: Kriss of Hateg
description: +3 weapon. A creature hit makes a Constitution save (DC 8 + PB) or shrinks one size and deals 1d4 less damage with its attacks for 1 minute.

name: The Taming Rod
description: +1 polearm or spear. You can attempt to tame an animal one additional time per day.

name: Razortooth Sword
description: Each hit adds 1 Bleed level, plus 1 per bonus (+1 to +3) instead of extra damage. Each Bleed level deals 1 Slashing at the start of the target's turn (or each minute outside combat); healing removes levels, and a rest, full HP, or a Medicine check (DC 6 + levels, max 15) clears them.

name: Barron's Blunderbuss
description: Common to +3. Load it with any ammunition or small scrap (range 60 feet when improvised); the DM can change its damage type to suit the load.

name: Trusty Rusty
description: +3 weapon. Burrow Speed 5 feet while wielded, and Advantage on attacks against stone creatures.

name: Protoceratops Quillbow
description: Its bolts burst with spines: each hit also deals 1d4 Piercing to every creature within 5 feet of the target.

name: Geological Hammer
description: Doubles as a tool for efficiently extracting resources from rock.

name: Theropod Jaw
description: Uncommon, Rare (+1), or Very Rare (+2). Each hit deals an extra 1d6 Piercing.

name: Azdarchid Beak Greatsword
description: Reach 10 feet for Opportunity Attacks, and Advantage against creatures from the Elemental Plane of Air.

name: Sauropod Femur
description: Weighs half as much as normal.

name: Wand of the Wondering Mind
description: 3 charges, regained at dawn. As an Action, a beast within 40 feet makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or you roll twice on its behaviour table and choose its behaviour.

name: Refractive Index Crystal
attunement_note: by a Druid, Sorcerer, or Wizard
description: Exceptional, Flawless, or Perfect. A spellcasting focus adding its bonus to spell attacks and save DCs; cast Light Proficiency Bonus times per day and Color Spray once per day without a slot.

name: Ancient Horn
description: A Bard focus. Once per day as an Action, sound a note only you and your allies hear, anywhere in the multiverse.

name: Primal Drums
description: A Bard focus. Once per day as an Action, cast Bless without a slot or components.

name: Staff of Time Sight
description: +2 staff and focus for Druids, Sorcerers, and Wizards. 2 charges (regains 1 at dawn): at the end of your turn, spend 1 to undo the whole turn and take it again.

name: Staff of Unspared Expense
description: Cursed +3 staff and focus for Druids, Sorcerers, and Wizards; Advantage on Charisma checks and saves. Vendors charge you 50 percent more, and it returns if abandoned. Selling it at double value breaks the curse; smashing it (DC 25 Strength) releases a hostile Tyrannosaurus rex.

name: Amber Necklace
description: +2 to rolls to resist or end Poisoned (doesn't stack with other amber).

name: Ring of Primal Speaking
description: You can read, speak, and understand Archosauric.

name: Ring of Palaeobotany
description: You recognize all ancient plants and know their uses and dangers.

name: Evolunite Shard
description: Dissolves on touching a creature, giving it a random minor mutation for 1 hour; more than five within an hour turns it into a 2-HP crab for an hour.

name: Potion of Redirected Ancestry
description: For 1 hour, take the appearance and species traits of a humanoid species you share an ancestor with; a second dose while transformed makes it permanent (Wish reverses).

name: Potion of Plumage
description: For 10 minutes you grow feathers: immune to falling damage and glide 1 foot horizontally per foot fallen.

name: Ethereal Egg
description: Incubate 2d4 days to hatch a permanent familiar of your choice (as Find Familiar). At 0 HP it vanishes and can be resummoned as an Action; the third time, it reverts to an egg.

name: Shell Coin
description: In settlements of 100+, it looks like the local highest-value coin; DC 12 Arcana detects magic, and dispelling reveals it.

name: Dice of the Dinosaur
description: First roll each day summons a hostile dinosaur matching the face within 1 mile (Iguanodon, Centrosaurus, Utahraptor, Zuul, Giraffatitan, Tyrannosaurus). Slain, it becomes amber worth 100 GP times the face number and that face goes blank; otherwise it vanishes at dawn.

name: Partridge Armour
description: +1 AC. Twice per day, as a Reaction when an enemy moves within 5 feet, fly up to 10 feet away without provoking.

name: Turtle Dove Dagger
description: Wielding the pair, twice per Long Rest as an Action create an illusory double within 30 feet for 1 minute or until you take damage. Attack or cast from its space, move it 30 feet as a Bonus Action (within 120 feet), and gain Advantage against a creature within 5 feet of both of you that can see it.

name: Trident of Henchantment
description: 4 charges (regains 1d4 at dawn). With the Attack action, spend 1 to cast Polymorph (DC 15) turning the target into a hen for 1 hour. On spending the last, 1 in 4 that it loses its magic.

name: Calling Quills
description: Four linked pads: writing on one appears on all for 12 hours.

name: Gold Rings of Might
description: Five rings worn together. Cast Shocking Grasp at will. 5 charges (regains 1 at dawn; ends forever if emptied): Lightning Bolt for 1 or Chain Lightning for 3 (DC 15) as a Magic action.

name: Goose Egg Healing Grenade
description: Once per day as an Action, throw it up to 40 feet: up to six creatures within 30 feet regain 2d8 + 4 HP (5d8 + 4 within 10 feet), lowest HP first; no effect on Undead or Constructs.

name: Swansong Staff
description: +1 to attack and damage. Once per day when you drop to 0 HP, it animates (as an Animated Broom) on your initiative to protect you until destroyed or you wake.

name: Phial of Stoutmilk
description: For 1 hour, reduce Bludgeoning damage you take by 1d4, and your Strength and Constitution increase by 2.

name: Wand of Dancing
description: Cast Otto's Irresistible Dance (DC 14) at will until a creature fails its save; then not until the next dawn.

name: Boots of Soft Landing
description: You always land on your feet, can't be knocked Prone, fall at most 60 feet per round, and take no falling damage.

name: Babble Pipes
description: Once per day as an Action, each creature in a 30-foot Emanation that hears makes a DC 12 Wisdom save or is Frightened for 1 minute, Dashing away each turn; out of sight of you, it repeats the save.

name: Metronome Drum
description: Once per day, play it as an Action: up to three Humanoids within 30 feet make a DC 14 save (with Advantage if you're fighting them) or are Charmed and Friendly for 1 hour or until you stop; they know afterward.

name: Arcane Battery
description: A smooth oval stone etched with faintly glowing symbols. As a Magic action, touch it to a magic item that regains charges daily; that item regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges and the battery loses its magic.

name: Brooch of the Elements
description: A butterfly brooch whose central jewel swirls with iridescence. It has 3 charges, regained daily at dawn. As a Reaction when a creature you can see within 60 feet hits with an attack roll and deals damage, expend 1 charge to change one of the attack's damage types to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder.

name: Fork of Eddy Summoning
description: A Tiny tuning fork crackling with harmless magical energy. As a Magic action, tap it on an object to summon a Friendly Eldritch Eddy as close to you as possible. It obeys your commands (defending itself if given none) and acts right after you on your Initiative count, disappearing after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. Once used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

name: Hat of Vortexes
description: This hat has 3 charges, regained daily at dawn. As a Magic action while holding it, expend 1 charge to release a vortex filling a 10-foot Cube originating from you for 1 hour; its area is Difficult Terrain. You choose its look, such as multicolored or glittery.

name: Magen Handbell
description:
As a Magic action, ring this brass bell to summon a Terran Magen in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. It understands your languages, obeys you, and acts right after you on your Initiative count, disappearing after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The bell can't be used again for 1d6 days.
Berserk Magen. When the magen starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6; on a 6 it goes berserk, ignoring your commands and dismissal and attacking the nearest creature (or an object) each turn, until it disappears or a creature holding the bell takes an Influence action and succeeds on a DC 15 Persuasion check.

name: Mythallar Bracelet
description: A leather bracelet strung with three crystal beads from a decommissioned mythallar. As a Magic action, pluck a bead (which vanishes) to gain Advantage on Athletics checks for 1 minute. With all three beads gone, it loses its magic.

name: Mythallar Cloak
description: An electric-blue cloak studded with mythallar shards. It has 10 charges and regains 1d10 daily at dawn. As a Bonus Action, expend 1 charge to activate it for 1 minute (or until you end it): you gain a Fly Speed of 30 feet and can hover, and once per turn when you hit a creature with an attack roll and deal damage, it takes an extra 1d4 Radiant damage. If you are aloft when it ends, you fall.

name: Spell Scroll of Fireball
description: This spell scroll holds Fireball in a mystical cipher. If Fireball is on your spell list, you can read it to cast the spell with its normal casting time and no Material components; otherwise it is unintelligible. The scroll crumbles to dust once cast, but isn't lost if the casting is interrupted. If Fireball is above the level you can normally cast, make a DC 13 spellcasting ability check or the spell disappears with no effect. A Wizard can copy it into a spellbook with a DC 13 Arcana check; the scroll is destroyed either way.

name: Calimemnon Crystal
description:
An immaculately cut sixty-sided diamond, made with high elf magic, that imprisons the genie lords Calim and Memnon and more than a hundred other genies, visible screaming within to anyone with Truesight.
While attuned, you can use it as an Arcane Focus and have a Fly Speed of 30 feet and can hover. You can cast Create or Destroy Water, Enlarge/Reduce, Invisibility (self only), and Major Image from it (save DC 18).
Aura of Cold. A 20-foot Emanation deals 2d6 Cold damage (once per turn) to a creature when it enters or ends its turn there or the aura enters its space; you are unaffected and can toggle it as a Magic action.
Healing/Damage Rays. As a Magic action while holding it, fire six rays at one or more creatures within 60 feet, each either dealing damage (DC 18 Dexterity save, 6d6 + 6 Radiant, half on success) or healing 2d6 + 2 Hit Points. Once per dawn.
Random Properties. 1 minor and 1 major beneficial, 1 minor and 1 major detrimental property.
Destroying the Crystal. Only a Wish cast by its attuned creature can destroy it, releasing all the genies.

name: Crown of Horns
description:
A pale silver circlet ringed with four curved bones and set with a black diamond, holding the essence of Myrkul of the Dead Three. It seeks mortal agents to transform into undead scions and teleports away from unworthy wearers.
Cursed. Attuning extends its curse to you, removable only by Wish or Myrkul's will: you won't part with it or end attunement, you become Neutral Evil, and over 365 days you transform into a Lich under the DM's control (cosmetic until complete, fading if attunement ends first). Each use of Cone of Undeath or Myrkul's Hand adds a cumulative 10 percent chance of completing it instantly.
Cone of Undeath. As a Magic action, a 60-foot Cone: DC 18 Constitution save, 4d8 Necrotic damage, half on success; a Humanoid killed rises next turn as a Specter that obeys you.
Damage Immunity. Immunity to Necrotic damage.
Fear Aura. A 60-foot Emanation (toggled as a Bonus Action; inactive while you're Incapacitated): a creature entering or starting its turn there makes a DC 16 Wisdom save or is Frightened and must flee by the safest route, repeating the save if you damage it or it ends its turn over 120 feet away; success grants 1 minute of immunity.
Myrkul's Hand. Cast Power Word Kill once per dawn; a Humanoid killed rises next turn as a Wraith that obeys you.
Teleportation. Cast Teleport (the crown can also cast it on its own), once per 7 days.
Random Properties. 1 minor beneficial, 1 minor and 1 major detrimental property.
Sentience. Neutral Evil, Int 10, Wis 16, Cha 19, hearing and Darkvision 120 feet, telepathy in Common. It urges its wearer to slay the living, raise the dead, and sow fear.
Destroying the Crown. It is destroyed if worn by Kelemvor while he sits on Myrkul's former throne in the Bone Castle.

name: Domestic Wonder
description: A bipedal Mechanical Wonder of Calimport built for household chores, vaguely resembling its creator's species. Activate it by winding it with its unique key for 1 minute, taking the Utilize action each turn. It operates for 10 days or until touched with its key as a Utilize action. It is a Medium Construct ally (AC 9, HP 5, Speed 30 ft., immune to Poison, Exhaustion, and Poisoned) that understands Common but can't speak; if damage drops it to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution save (DC 5 + the damage) unless the damage is Lightning or a Critical Hit, dropping to 1 instead on a success. It acts right after you and obeys your verbal commands, otherwise Dodging and avoiding danger, and is destroyed at 0 Hit Points.

name: Flying Wonder
description: A Tiny flying Mechanical Wonder. Activate it by winding it with its unique key for 1 minute, taking the Utilize action each turn. It operates for 24 hours or until touched with its key as a Utilize action. It is a Construct ally (AC 12, HP 2, Speed 5 ft., Fly 30 ft., Blindsight 60 ft., immune to Poison, Exhaustion, and Poisoned) that understands Common, can carry 100 pounds, and as a Bonus Action can Dash or chime to give an ally within 60 feet Advantage on its next check with a Musical Instrument or Tinker's Tools. It acts right after you and obeys your verbal commands, otherwise Dodging and avoiding danger, and is destroyed at 0 Hit Points.

name: Gyrocopter Wonder
description: A wagon-sized brassy vehicle with a spiral propeller and an open midsection. Activate it by winding it with its unique key for 1 minute, taking the Utilize action each turn. It stays active for 8 hours as a one-pilot vehicle: a Huge object weighing 500 pounds with AC 14, HP 50, Speed 5 ft., and Fly Speed 20 ft., carrying up to 2,000 pounds (deactivating if overloaded). Eight spectral cords inside let riders attach or detach as a Utilize action; an attached creature can leap out and glide 5 feet horizontally per 1 foot of descent, and its cord vanishes back to the wonder if it gets more than 500 feet away.

name: Harper Pin
description: When you attune to this pin, choose a Harper persona with an alignment and creature type. While wearing it, magic that determines your creature type, alignment, or location registers you as that persona. The type of pin sets its rarity and further effects.

name: Mobility Wonder
description: A metal turtle shell with straps, worn on your back or flank. Activate it by winding it with its unique key for 1 minute, taking the Utilize action each turn. Once wound it becomes a personal transport device for 24 hours, increasing your Speed to 30 feet, and others can't remove it from you unless you allow it.

name: Orb of Damara
description:
A 6-inch orb of glassy, iridescent, incredibly hard material created by the wizard Damara, aided by an aspect of Tiamat, as a means of becoming a dragon; it shrinks to the size of a grape when held to the lips to be eaten.
While attuned, you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can hover.
Dragon's Breath. As a Magic action, exhale a 15-foot Cone of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison: DC 18 Dexterity save, 6d6 damage, half on success.
Fear Aura. A 20-foot Emanation (toggled as a Magic action; inactive while Incapacitated): an enemy starting its turn there makes a DC 18 Wisdom save or is Frightened until the start of its next turn; success grants 24 hours of immunity.
Random Properties. 2 minor beneficial and 2 minor detrimental properties.
Spellcasting. It has 6 charges and regains 1d4 + 2 daily at dawn, casting spells from its table (+10 to hit, save DC 18) for the listed charges.
Dragon Transformation. Swallowing it permanently transforms you into an adult chromatic dragon under the DM's control; if slain, the body reverts and the orb reappears.
Destroying the Orb. An Ancient Gold Dragon that willingly swallows it destroys both itself and the orb.

name: Tome of the Dragon
description:
A heavy dragonhide tome banded with cold iron, bearing the Cult of the Dragon's symbol, holding the ritual to turn a living or dead dragon into a dracolich. Using it requires a spellcaster with at least two level 5 spell slots or a Dragon; qualified assistants can help.
The ritual needs continuous access to an adult or ancient dragon's body and 80,000 GP of supplies (including a gem to anchor its spirit), and takes 180 days divided by the number of participants, working uninterrupted with no more than 8 hours' rest a day; a Dragon conducting it halves the cost and time. At the end, the tome explodes in violet light, dealing 12d6 Necrotic damage to each participant; any killed reanimate as Zombies under the DM's control. A living dragon dies and its spirit enters the gem; a dead dragon's body reanimates, inhabited by an evil dragon spirit from the Outer Planes. The dracolich owes its creators nothing.

name: Windskiff
description: A small piece of jewelry with 3 charges, regained daily at dawn. As a Magic action, expend 1 charge to transform it into a door-sized sail-powered vehicle with a 10-foot sail for 1 hour or until you speak its command word. It is a Medium object with AC 12, HP 30, and Speed 40 ft. that hovers a few inches above any surface and glides 5 feet horizontally per 1 foot of descent; it and its riders take no falling damage.

name: Amulet of Incineration
description:
A bone talisman holding an ever-burning gem of entropic flame dust, glazed in aberration blood.
Once per turn, when you cast a spell with a spell slot that deals Fire damage, one target that took Fire damage from it gains the Burning condition (3d6 Fire).
Crafting: Rare Workshop; elemental animus, monstrosity spine, entropic flame dust, aberration blood.

name: Amulet of Primal Wisdom
description:
A pendant of dried magical leaves and a single flower sealed in sap, smelling of spring meadows.
Your Wisdom is 19 while you wear it; it has no effect if your Wisdom is already 19 or higher.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; plant animus, plant dust, sap, leaves, and a flower.

name: Aqua Delerium
description:
A dimly glowing purple potion swirling with octarine light.
Drinking it restores expended spell slots with a combined level up to 1d6 (none above level 5). For 1 hour afterward, roll 1d20 whenever you cast a spell of level 1 or higher; on a 1 you trigger a random Arcane Anomaly.
A second dose before a Long Rest deals 1d12 Necrotic per slot level it restores and lowers your Hit Point maximum by that much until a Long Rest; this damage can't be reduced or prevented. A creature that can't cast spells with slots instead takes 10 (3d6) Necrotic and gains a Contamination level.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, aberrant dust, contaminated ichor, any glands.

name: Aqua Expurgo
description:
A syringe of bright orange arcane fluid, injected into your own heart or a willing creature's with a Utilize action.
For 6 hours, up to three times, when you fail a save against an effect that would give you Contamination levels you can succeed instead. Once the third use is spent, you take 10 (3d6) Necrotic that can't be reduced, are Incapacitated for 1 minute while retching, and your Hit Point maximum drops by the damage until a Long Rest; you die if it reaches 0.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, aberrant dust, contaminated ichor, a plant flower (traditionally an eldritch lily).

name: Blade of Retribution
description:
A blade forged with celestial dust, its hilt wrapped in fiend leather and set with a polished dragon's eye.
When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack with it, you can cast Divine Smite as part of that action without expending a spell slot.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, celestial dust, monster blood, fiend skin, dragon eye.

name: Bracers of Arc Lightning
description:
Leather bracers trimmed with magical scales and powered by the animus of a lightning-wielding creature.
You have Resistance to Lightning damage and immunity to the Shocked condition. The bracers have 6 charges, regained daily at dawn. Once per turn when you hit with a ranged weapon attack, you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra 3d6 Lightning, and the target is Shocked until the start of your next turn.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; animus from a Lightning-dealing creature (such as a blue dragon), elemental dust, elemental fluid, contaminated ichor, skin, scales.

name: Charged Gauntlets
description:
Light gauntlets of fiend-hair cloth reinforced with dragon scales and powered by an aberrant animus.
Each Unarmed Strike hit adds a charge (maximum 10); charges vanish when you finish a Long Rest or roll Initiative. With 1 or more charges your Unarmed Strikes deal Lightning damage; with 5 or more they also deal an extra 2d6 Lightning and push the target 10 feet. Spend 2 charges to cast Shield, or 10 charges to cast Destructive Wave or Wall of Force using your Monk focus save DC.
Crafting: Very Rare Workshop; aberrant animus, undead dust, elemental fluid, fiend hair, blue or bronze dragon scales.

name: Charm of Swarms
description:
A gnat-shaped charm of dead spores and insect mandibles, held together with dried mucus and acidic bile.
When an enemy within 5 feet scores a Critical Hit against you, you can give it the Burning condition (2d6 Necrotic); while it burns this way, you have Advantage on attacks against it.
Crafting: Uncommon Workshop; any animus, acidic bile, mucus, spores, mandibles.

name: Circlet of Valor
description:
A steel circlet forged from construct plating, set with a fiend's animus, and cleansed in dragonfire.
When you cast a spell of level 1 or higher that restores Hit Points to a creature, it gains Valor (1d4) until the end of its next turn.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; fiend animus, any dust, construct plates, dragon glands.

name: Cold Snap Circlet
description:
A permanently frozen circlet of contaminated ichor and undead bone, chilled by the heart of a cold creature yet comfortable to wear.
Once per turn, when you cast a spell with a spell slot that deals Cold damage, one target that took Cold damage from it gains the Frozen condition (escape DC equals your spell save DC).
Crafting: Rare Workshop; elemental animus, undead ribs, contaminated ichor, the heart of a white or silver dragon, winter troll, or other Cold-immune monster.

name: Crest of the Sacred Flame
description:
A simple crest of undead bone and sanctified fiend dust, washed in acidic bile and fired with draconic elemental fluid.
Your Aura of Protection's Emanation grows by 10 feet.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, spine or ribs, fiend dust, acidic bile, elemental fluid.

name: Crimson Blade
description:
A blackened blade dripping blood-red ichor, forged with vampire dust and a dragon's heart, its gold hilt set with a ruby and vampire fangs.
You gain +2 to attack and damage rolls with it. A creature you hit that isn't a Construct or Undead takes an extra 3d6 Necrotic, and you regain Hit Points equal to that Necrotic damage.
Curse. While attuned, you can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.
Crafting: Very Rare Workshop; sanguine witch animus, vampire dust, undead blood, vampire teeth, dragon heart.

name: Dazing Hammer
description:
A hammer of giant bone forged in undead dust and stained with monster blood.
You gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with it. On a Critical Hit, the target is Dazed until the start of your next turn.
Crafting: Uncommon Workshop; any animus, giant skull, undead dust, monster blood.

name: Electric Charge Ring
description:
A ring of living lightning around a construct's lens eye, set in an elemental animus.
When you cast a spell with a spell slot that deals Lightning damage, one target that failed its first save against it is Shocked until the start of your next turn.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; elemental animus, elemental dust, construct eye, glands.

name: Everhot Stew Pot
description:
A cauldron of construct iron infused with elemental ash and a dragon's animus, with a bone stirring spoon. It boils without fire and its stews are always hearty.
During a Long Rest you can cook stew for up to three creatures; each who eats it gains 10 Temporary Hit Points and has Valor (1d4) while they last.
Crafting: Uncommon Workshop; dragon animus, monstrosity ribs, elemental dust, plates.

name: Familiar Figurine
description:
A finely carved figurine. Once per day, as a Magic action, you can cast Find Familiar with it.
Crafting: Uncommon Workshop; any animus, giant bones, elemental or fey dust.

name: Fractal Key
description:
A spiral bone key. As an action, a creature in a Thin Place can open a gate to the Ethereal Plane for 1 minute, after which the key crumbles to dust.
Crafting: Rare forge; animus from a fractal lepidoptera, bones of any Rare creature.

name: Frozen Armor
description:
Armor threaded with veins of elemental fluid and set with a frost giant's animus.
You have Resistance to Cold damage and immunity to the Frozen condition. It has 6 charges, regained daily at dawn; when a melee attack hits you, you can use your Reaction and 1 charge to force the attacker to make a DC 15 Constitution save or be Frozen (DC 15).
Crafting: Rare Workshop; frost giant animus, elemental dust, contaminated ichor, elemental fluid.

name: Ghost Sight Bow
description:
A semi-corporeal bow of dryad bone stained in vampire blood, strung with banshee hair around a wraith animus.
You gain +2 to attack and damage rolls with it, and it creates spectral ammunition that deals Force damage and vanishes after each shot. As a Bonus Action, if you haven't moved this turn, you can see into the Ethereal Plane, see invisible creatures and objects, and see through solid objects within 60 feet until the end of your turn; your arrows then pass through objects, letting you attack creatures within 60 feet even behind Total Cover, and your Speed becomes 0 until the turn ends.
Crafting: Very Rare Workshop; wraith animus, dryad skull, undead dust, ectoplasm, undead blood, banshee hair.

name: Giant Femur Club
description:
A polished giant femur topped with a troll skull studded with monstrous teeth, crackling with elemental power.
You gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with it and have Advantage on attacks against Giants. It deals an extra 2d6 damage of the type tied to its elemental dust (for example, Lightning for storm troll dust or Necrotic for eldritch troll dust).
Crafting: Rare Workshop; troll animus, troll skull, giant bone, troll elemental dust, monstrosity skin, giant, beast, or monstrosity teeth.

name: Gloves of Ratling Agility
description:
Gloves of ratling hide.
Your Dexterity is 19 while you wear them; they have no effect if your Dexterity is already 19 or higher.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, ratling fur, ratling skin, monstrosity guts.

name: Greater Rejuvenation Potion
description:
Drinking this potion immediately grants you the benefits of a Long Rest. Afterward, you can't benefit from another until you finish 3d6 Long Rests.
Crafting: Legendary Workshop; any animus, any giant bones, fey dust, elemental fluid, dragon blood, celestial hair, aberration brain, fiend heart.

name: Hag-Stitched Troll Leather Armor
description:
You gain +1 to AC while wearing it. It has 50 charges, regained daily at dawn. At the start of your turn you can spend 1 to 10 charges, regaining 1 Hit Point per charge. Each point of Acid or Fire damage you take while wearing it drains 1 charge.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; giant animus, two troll skulls, troll blood, stitches, troll skin.

name: Hammer of Chaos
description:
A hammer of melted construct plates infused with elemental fluid and dust and soaked in aberrant brain matter, hafted with fiend leather and dragon ribs.
You gain +3 to attack and damage rolls with it, and it has the Thrown property (range 30/90). On a hit, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder; it deals an extra 2d8 of that type. When a ranged hit rolls matching numbers on two or more of those d8s, it ricochets to another target of your choice within 30 feet for a new attack and damage roll, then returns to your hand.
Crafting: Legendary Workshop; any animus, dragon spine, elemental dust, elemental fluid, construct plates, fiend skin, aberration brain.

name: Hazewind Cape
description:
A crimson and gold hooded cape fitted with harpy feathers and dyed in their blood, infused with fey dust.
While wearing it, you have Advantage on saves against the Charmed and Frightened conditions.
Crafting: Uncommon Workshop; harpy animus, fey dust, harpy blood, harpy feathers, skin.

name: Heart String Harp
description:
An ivory harp strung with dragon heart sinew and fey hair, its notes carrying faint draconic whispers.
You can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for Bard spells and gain +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC. When you cast an Enchantment spell of level 1 to 5 that targets only one creature through it, you can target a second creature in range.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; fey animus, fey hair (at the GM's option, freely given), fey, monstrosity, or dragon horns or teeth, dragon heart.

name: Helm of Burning Rage
description:
A helm of construct plates forged with a red dragon's heart and a fire giant's animus.
While Raging you have Resistance to Fire damage, and once per turn, when you hit with a melee weapon attack that benefited from Reckless Attack, the target gains the Burning condition (2d4 Fire).
Crafting: Rare Workshop; fire giant animus, elemental dust, elemental fluid, plates, red dragon heart.

name: Inexhaustible Armor
description:
Armor of fey leather and magical plates infused with construct chemicals and a gorgon's heart.
You gain an extra use of Second Wind. When you use Second Wind, you regain an extra 3d6 Hit Points and can end Blinded, Charmed, Dazed, Deafened, Frightened, Immobilized, Poisoned, Slowed, or Staggered on yourself.
Crafting: Very Rare Workshop; any animus, construct chemical solution, fey skin, plates, gorgon heart.

name: Mantle of Otherworldly Charisma
description:
A cape of monstrosity fur and skin with fiend horns, dusted with fey dust.
Your Charisma is 19 while you wear it; it has no effect if your Charisma is already 19 or higher.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, monstrosity fur, monstrosity skin, fiend horns, fey dust.

name: Manual of Occult Anatomy
description:
A book of alien anatomical diagrams written in monster-blood ink on aberration-skin pages, bound in scales.
You can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for Warlock spells, gaining a bonus to their spell attack rolls and save DCs set by its rarity, and while attuned you know one Eldritch Invocation chosen at creation, up to a level set by its rarity. (The rarity table is not reproduced here.)
Crafting: Workshop and components of the item's rarity; any animus, dragon dust, monstrosity blood, scales, aberration skin.

name: Mask of Monstrous Forms
description:
A mask carved from the skull of a monstrosity of CR 6 or lower, boiled in mimic mucus and doppelganger flesh, with a shapechanger's animus on the brow.
You can expend two uses of Wild Shape to become the monstrosity the mask was made from instead of a Beast.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; shapechanger animus, monstrosity skull (sets the form), aberrant dust, acidic bile, mimic mucus, doppelganger flesh.

name: Pelt of the Pack Lord
description:
A cape of garmyr fur stitched to ratling leather and hung with harpy talons.
While you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature, your allies have Advantage on attacks against it.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; monstrosity animus, contaminated ichor, garmyr fur, ratling skin, harpy claws.

name: Pendant of Prismatic Protection
description:
A jeweled pendant with 3 charges, regained when you finish a Long Rest. When you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison damage, you can use your Reaction and 1 charge to gain Resistance to that type until the end of your next turn.
Crafting: Uncommon Workshop; elemental animus, elemental dust, two elemental fluids from different elementals.

name: Potion of Controlled Mutation
description:
A sickly, fishy potion holding a writhing mass of tentacles that crawl down your throat.
You gain one random Mutation (roll twice on the Mutations table and choose) until you start a Short or Long Rest, without gaining Contamination levels; then your body returns to normal.
Crafting: Uncommon Workshop; aberration animus, contaminated ichor, two aberration organs.

name: Rat Tooth Dagger
description:
When you hit as part of the Attack action with this dagger and apply Sneak Attack, you can make one more attack with it as part of that action; if it hits and qualifies, it adds half your Sneak Attack dice (rounded down).
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, venom, bark, ratling claws.

name: Reflector Shield
description:
A shield of anomollusk shell with an aberration-leather grip, shimmering in kaleidoscopic hues.
When a creature you can see within 60 feet deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, or Thunder damage to you, you can use your Reaction to deal it the same damage (you still take yours).
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, contaminated ichor, anomollusk shell, aberration skin.

name: Rejuvenation Potion
description:
A bright purple potion. Drinking it immediately grants the benefits of a Short Rest; afterward you can't benefit from another until you finish 1d4 Long Rests.
Crafting: Very Rare Workshop; any animus, fey dust, elemental fluid, dragon blood, fiend heart.

name: Retracer Boots
description:
Dragonhide boots trimmed with harpy feathers and webbed membranes, their soles filled with ooze.
As a Bonus Action you click the heels and teleport to the space you occupied at the start of your turn, if it is unoccupied.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, goopy ooze, dragon scales, webbed membrane, harpy feathers, dragon flesh.

name: Scroll of Spell Power
description:
When you roll damage for a spell of level 1 or higher, you can expend this scroll to reroll up to that spell's level in damage dice, using the new rolls.
Crafting: Uncommon Workshop; any animus, fey, dragon, or giant blood, monstrosity skin.

name: Scythed Arm Blades
description:
A pair of 4-foot scythe blades on bone-spine bracers set with delerium crystals; they work only as a pair, attuned as one item.
You gain +2 to attack and damage rolls with them, and you can use the Nick mastery property alongside another mastery property with them.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, spine, plates, beast or monstrosity skin, two reautomata blades.

name: Sword Between Worlds
description:
A starmetal blade quenched in far dweller spinal fluid, its octarine sheen reflecting other realities, with a warp marauder grip and a far dweller's essence in the pommel.
You gain +2 to attack and damage rolls with it. Once per turn when you score a Critical Hit or drop a creature to 0 Hit Points with it, you can teleport to a space you can see within 120 feet. Once per turn when you teleport to within 5 feet of a creature while wielding it, you can attack that creature with it as part of the teleporting action or Bonus Action. As a Magic action you can cast Dimension Door, once per Short or Long Rest.
Curse. You have Disadvantage on saves against effects that would forcibly teleport you or send you to another plane.
Crafting: Very Rare Workshop; aberration animus, aberration skull, spine, or ribs, far dweller ichor, aberration skin, warp marauder tentacles.

name: Talon Gloves
description:
Leather gloves fitted with beast talons and bone reinforcement.
You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and your Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d6 Piercing on a hit.
Crafting: Uncommon Workshop; any animus, elemental fluid, stitches, skin, claws.

name: Tentacle Whip
description:
A writhing whip of aberrant tentacles and guts fused to webbed membranes and plant bark.
You gain +2 to attack and damage rolls with it, and it has a reach of 20 feet. Once per turn when you hit a Large or smaller creature with it, you can pull that creature 10 feet toward you.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, stitches, bark, webbed membrane, aberration tentacles.

name: Time Dilation Medallion
description:
A clockwork medallion around a focusing lens, powered by the animus of the Algorithm.
It has 3 charges and crumbles when the last is spent. Spend 1 charge to take an extra action on your turn, then roll 1d6: on a 1 the medallion casts Maze on you at the end of your turn; on a 6 it regains 1d3 charges.
Crafting: Legendary Workshop; the Algorithm's animus (or another Legendary Construct's, at the GM's discretion), construct plates, any needles, construct eye.

name: Trollblood Potion
description:
A bubbling, mucus-thick green-brown brew with a rotting troll eye floating in it.
For 1 minute after drinking it, you regain 5 Hit Points at the start of your turn, ending early if you take Fire or Acid damage.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; fey animus, troll blood, troll eyes.

name: Vampire Blood Potion
description:
A crimson, coppery brew. For 1 minute after drinking it, you have Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Charisma attack rolls, ability checks, and saves, and if damage other than Radiant or a Critical Hit drops you to 0 Hit Points you make a Constitution save (DC 5 + half the damage), dropping to 1 Hit Point instead on a success and ending the potion. It ends early if you take Radiant damage or enter sunlight.
Crafting: Very Rare Workshop; undead animus, vampire dust, ectoplasm, vampire blood.

name: Wand of Jinxes
description:
A wand of magical bark with an undead hair core, finished in ooze.
Once per turn when you damage a creature with a Warlock cantrip, you can make it Jinxed (1d4) until the start of your next turn.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, goopy ooze, undead hair, bark.

name: Wand of the Precocious Apprentice
description:
Once per turn when you damage a creature with a cantrip while holding this wand, one target of the cantrip takes an extra 1d4 damage of the spell's type.
Crafting: Uncommon Workshop; any animus, undead bones, fey dust, ectoplasm.

name: Whirling Bonesaw
description:
A ripper's blade refitted into construct plating and monstrosity ribs, driven by a belt and an elemental-fueled motor.
You gain +3 to attack and damage rolls with it. Once on your turn when you hit a Bloodied creature with it, you can make one more attack with it as part of that action.
Crafting: Very Rare Workshop; any animus, ribs, elemental fluid, plates, monstrosity skin, ripper blade.

name: Champion's Weapon
description:
Attacks with this weapon score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
Crafting: Uncommon Workshop; any animus, bones, sap, plates.

name: Injector's Crossbow
description:
A plated oak crossbow fed by an alchemical chamber and an auto-loading wheel of syringe darts.
You gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with it, it ignores the Loading property, and you don't need a free hand to load it. Once per turn when you hit with it, apply one poison: Virulent (an extra 2d6 Poison); Weakening (DC 15 Constitution save or Weakened until the start of your next turn); or Immobilizing (DC 15 Strength save or Immobilized until the start of your next turn).
Crafting: Rare Workshop; any animus, chemical solution, hair, plates, skin, injector needles.

name: Monster Hunter's Weapon
description:
A weapon of bark with a magical sap core, decorated with enchanted leaves and bound in fey hair.
You gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls with it and to your Ranger spell attack rolls and save DCs, set by its rarity (the table is not reproduced here), and can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for Ranger spells. When you hit with it, you can expend a Ranger spell slot to cast Hunter's Mark on the target as part of the attack; cast this way it needs no Concentration and lasts 1 minute or until the target dies or you cast Hunter's Mark again.
Crafting: Workshop and components of the item's rarity; any animus, sap, fey hair, leaves, bark.

name: Necromancer's Armor
description:
Bone armor over black cloth, with skull pauldrons, a spine, and a rib cage, studded with fangs and powered by an undead animus.
You are proficient with it regardless of armor training. While within 30 feet of an Undead under your control, you have Resistance to all damage except Radiant, but each time you take damage, one such Undead within 30 feet takes the same damage, which can't be reduced or prevented.
Crafting: Rare Workshop; undead animus, ribs, skull, spine, contaminated ichor, teeth.

name: Swashbuckler's Boots
description:
Supple leather boots. Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.
Crafting: Uncommon Workshop; any animus, fey dust, elemental fluid, any hide.

name: Amber Birdcage
description:
An amber birdcage that replaces your torso while you are attuned, separating when attunement ends.
Sense Fiends. As a Bonus Action, you sense Fiends and Fiend-made magical effects within 60 feet.
Capture Fiend. As a Magic action, a Bloodied Fiend you can see within 60 feet makes a DC 15 Charisma save or becomes an inert amber songbird trapped in the cage. You can remove one songbird as a Bonus Action; if you stop holding it, the Fiend returns to full Hit Points and is hostile to you.
Consume Songbird. As a Magic action, you eat a songbird you hold; the Fiend dies and you either regain one spell slot of level up to half its CR or gain Temporary Hit Points equal to its CR.
Amber Curse. You take a -1 penalty to Wisdom saves, growing by 1 each time you use Capture Fiend or Consume Songbird.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Axe of the Galloping Headsman
description:
A curved axe edged in dark fire, its handle wrapped in cracked leather and etched with malevolent runes. It grants its rarity's bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Fiery Smite (Rare+). Hits deal an extra 1d6 Fire, or 1d10 against a creature that damaged you since your last turn ended.
Mark of Guilt (Very Rare+). On a hit you can mark the creature, knowing its direction and distance (or its destination plane if it leaves, which ends the mark) until you mark another or it dies.
Sense Guilt (Very Rare+). As a Bonus Action, you hold the blade to a creature's neck; it makes a Charisma save (DC 16 + the axe's bonus) or you learn something it feels guilty about. It is then immune for 24 hours.
Dark Binding (Legendary). Once on your turn after a hit, you can use a Bonus Action to force a DC 19 Strength save or the target is Paralyzed and Prone until your next turn, kneeling with neck bared if it can.
Executioner's Blade (Legendary). Against a Prone creature you score a Critical Hit on a 19 or 20; a Critical Hit deals an extra 3d6 Fire, and a creature left with 20 or fewer Hit Points makes a DC 10 Constitution save or dies.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Banjo of Ol' Jericho Sticks
description:
A weathered, rune-carved banjo that belonged to a hag-made scarecrow bard. While holding it you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus and gain its rarity's bonus to spell attack rolls, spell save DC, and Charisma (Performance) checks.
Fiendish Lure (Rare+). As a Magic action, a Fiend or Humanoid you can see within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save (DC 16 + the banjo's bonus) or is Charmed for 1 minute (ignoring a demon's immunity), ending if you or allies damage it or force it to save. Once a creature is Charmed, not again until the next dusk.
Scarecrow's Dance (Rare+). As a Bonus Action, you strum and dance to take the Disengage action; the music carries 120 feet.
Join in the Dance (Very Rare+). When you use Scarecrow's Dance, one creature you choose within 15 feet can use its Reaction to move half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Birdcage (Legendary). As a Magic action, a creature you have Charmed makes a DC 19 Charisma save or is drawn into the banjo for up to 24 hours (one at a time); on a success the charm ends.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Bell of the Dusk Mother
description:
A heavy filigreed iron handbell that only ever tolls mournfully. While holding it you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus and gain its rarity's bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
Dolorous Tolling (Rare+). As a Magic action, creatures of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation make a Wisdom save (DC 16 + the bell's bonus) or take 3d10 Psychic and subtract 1d4 from attack rolls and saves for 1 minute. Once per dusk.
Call of the Bell (Very Rare+). As a Bonus Action, you shape a 5-foot Cube of wood, clay, or stone within 10 feet into an obedient doll (Animated Armor stat block) that acts after you for 10 minutes or until it dies. Once per dusk.
Death Knell (Legendary). As a Magic action, each Bloodied creature in a 30-foot Emanation makes a DC 19 Constitution save, taking 5d10 Necrotic or half on success, and dropping to 0 Hit Points on a failure by 5 or more. Once per dusk.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Black Candle
description:
A black tallow candle carved with arcane symbols whose pale gray flame never burns it down.
Word of Flame and Darkness. As a Bonus Action within 60 feet, you speak a command word to light or snuff it; lit, it sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius.
Witchlight. While in its light, you can cast a level 1 or 2 spell without a slot (that spell then can't be cast this way again for 24 hours), and you make a Constitution save (starting at DC 0) or take Fire damage equal to 2d6 times the spell's level.
Cursed Candle. After each Witchlight save, its DC rises by 2, at most once per Long Rest. While the DC is 10 or higher, you have Vulnerability to Necrotic damage.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Bloody Fiddle
description:
A scarlet-lacquered, blood-warm fiddle with a clear, strong voice. While holding it you gain +2 to Charisma (Performance) checks.
Song of Stirred Blood. As a Magic action, up to six creatures of your choice within 30 feet gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d10 + your Proficiency Bonus, plus a Bardic Inspiration die if you spend one. Once per dusk.
Sanguine Curse. The first time you play it after a Long Rest, you take 1 Slashing damage that ignores Resistance, increasing by 1 each time you use Song of Stirred Blood.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Blunderbuss of the Grinning Sinner
description:
A brass-barreled blunderbuss etched with hexes. It works as a Musket that ignores Loading and makes its own ammunition dealing Necrotic damage, grants its rarity's bonus to attack and damage rolls, and can serve as a Spellcasting Focus.
Jinxshot (Rare+). You can replace one attack in your Attack action with a blast: each creature in a 30-foot Cone makes a Dexterity save (DC 16 + the bonus), taking 2d4 Necrotic (Rare) or 3d6 Necrotic (Very Rare+), half on success.
Sinner's Jinx (Very Rare+). Once on your turn when you damage a creature with it, the creature makes a Charisma save (DC 16 + the bonus) or is cursed for 1 minute, subtracting 1d4 from D20 Tests, until you curse another.
Luck Taker (Legendary). When a creature it has cursed within 60 feet rolls a 19 or 20 on a D20 Test, you can use your Reaction to make your next D20 Test within 1 minute use that number.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Cane of Phillip Druskenvald
description:
A polished black cane topped with a silver goat skull that stirs greed in all but the humble. While holding it you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus and gain its rarity's bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
Eldritch Glutton (Rare+). When you succeed on a save against a spell targeting only you, you can use your Reaction to absorb it harmlessly into the cane; later, as a Magic action, you regain a spell slot at least one level lower or gain Temporary Hit Points equal to three times its level. A new absorption replaces stored energy. Once per dusk.
Allure of Sin (Very Rare+). You can cast Dominate Person (save DC 16 + the bonus); once a creature is Charmed by it, not again until the next dusk.
Sin-Binder's Call (Legendary). As a Magic action, you summon three Hell Hounds, an Incubus, or a Succubus within 30 feet that obey you and act after you for 10 minutes, then become Indifferent or Friendly if treated well. Once per dusk.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Cauldron of the Vermintoll Coven
description:
A tarnished, rune-rimmed cauldron of strange dark liquid that never spills. While holding it you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus and gain its rarity's bonus to all saves.
Size Change (Rare+). A 1-minute ritual switches it between Tiny (1 lb.) and Medium (80 lb.); when Medium it walks at Speed 20 on your command.
Cookpot (Rare+). During a Short or Long Rest the Medium cauldron feeds up to ten creatures, each gaining 2d6 Temporary Hit Points at the end of the rest.
Vermincall (Rare+). As a Magic action you spill it to cast Conjure Animals as grotesque insects or rats. Once per dusk.
Fortifying Gorge (Very Rare+). With Cookpot, one diner of your choice gains +2 AC from monstrous, hardened skin until it finishes a Short or Long Rest.
Coven Abomination (Legendary). As a Bonus Action you or a creature within 5 feet drinks from it: for 1 hour the drinker becomes at least Large, gains 5 feet of reach, and deals an extra 1d8 damage with melee attacks, then is Incapacitated for 1 minute as its bones shrink.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Chunk of Oozing Fungus
description:
A pallid, oozing, spore-shedding fungal lump.
Spore Cloud. As a Magic action you throw it up to 30 feet, where it bursts in a 30-foot Sphere; each other creature there makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 3d8 Poison and being Poisoned until your next turn (and also Incapacitated on a failure by 5 or more), or half damage on success.
Regrow. As a Bonus Action you cough up a new chunk, making a DC 10 Constitution save or losing 5 from your Hit Point maximum.
Fungal Curse. You take a -1 penalty to Constitution saves, growing by 1 after each Regrow save.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Crown of the Barrow King
description:
A crown of twisted iron with five blood-crusted spikes. While worn it grants its rarity's bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC for Necromancy spells and spells that deal Necrotic damage.
Demand of the Dead (Rare+). You can cast Speak with Dead from it.
Grave Grasp (Rare+). You know Chill Touch, with a spell attack bonus of +9, +10, or +11 by rarity.
Necromancer's Call (Rare+). You can cast Animate Dead from it three times, regaining uses at dusk.
Master of Undeath (Very Rare+). Undead you create or summon have double Hit Points and Advantage on saves.
Soul Transfer (Very Rare+). When you drop to 0 Hit Points or fail a Death Saving Throw, you can move your soul into an Undead you created within 1 mile; your old body dies, you keep only the crown, and you use your statistics with its current Hit Points. Once per dusk.
Compel Undead (Legendary). As a Magic action, an Undead within 30 feet makes a DC 19 Wisdom save or is Charmed and obeys you for 1 minute, ending early if it becomes Bloodied.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Cutlass of Briggsy Kratch
description:
The jinx-laden cutlass of pirate captain Briggsy Kratch, its skull-and-crossbones hilt and glowing runes pulsing with power. It grants its rarity's bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Raise the Stakes (Rare+). As a Bonus Action you mark a creature within 5 feet until your next turn and count hits each way; whoever lands fewer hits takes 2d10 Psychic, or both do on a tie. Once per dusk.
Sea Legs (Rare+). When you Disengage, Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement until your turn ends.
Double Down (Very Rare+). Your Attack action gains one extra attack against your Raise the Stakes target.
Jinxcraft Panache (Very Rare+). When a creature that already damaged you this turn hits you, you can use your Reaction to add twice the cutlass's bonus to your AC against that attack.
Hex Ward (Legendary). Divination spells can't target you and scrying sensors can't perceive you, and a creature that curses you takes Psychic damage equal to your level.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Devilbone Button
description:
A bone button carved with a tiny devil, attuned only while sewn onto clothing you wear. You gain +1 to saves.
Improbable Luck. When you fail a save, you can succeed instead. Once per dusk.
Protective Bone. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 5 + your Constitution modifier.
Diabolic Curse. After each Long Rest there is a 1 percent chance (plus 1 percent per use of Improbable Luck) that the button vanishes, ending attunement, and a devil of CR equal to your level + 3 (maximum 20), detailed by the GM, becomes your sworn enemy.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Draught of the Red Hunger
description:
A red more intense than natural blood. Drinking it gives you a ravenous thirst and the effect of Vampiric Touch (level 6, no Concentration) for 1 minute, repeating the attack as a Bonus Action.
Heightened Potency. For the duration, out of sunlight, you can take a Magic action to gain Gaseous Form (no Concentration) or revert.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Elixir of Fogwalking
description:
A murky gray potion in a lantern-shaped bottle with a cobblestone base. For 10 minutes your breath billows fog, fog and smoke don't hinder your vision, and you can cast Fog Cloud (no Concentration) and Misty Step (beginning or ending in fog) up to three times each.
Heightened Potency. The duration becomes 1 hour, and casting Misty Step this way also gives you Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until your next turn.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Eye of the White Worm
description:
A cold, clammy, purple-veined eyeball whose pupil never stops searching. While holding it you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus and gain its rarity's bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
Thought Scour (Rare+). You can cast Detect Thoughts (save DC 16 + the bonus); probing deeper deals 3d8 Psychic to an unwilling target. Once per dusk.
Mnemonic Siphon (Very Rare+). You can cast Modify Memory (save DC 16 + the bonus), gaining a version of the changed memory you know isn't yours. Once per dusk.
Violation of the Real (Very Rare+). A damaging Conjuration spell you cast with a slot, or a damaging creature it summons, deals an extra 1d10 Psychic to one target the first time it deals damage each turn.
Enduring Violation (Legendary). A Conjuration spell you cast with a duration of 1 hour or more can last 24 hours without Concentration. Once per dusk.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Green Ribbon
description:
A green satin ribbon sized for a neck that you never quite want to remove. While worn, you gain +5 to Death Saving Throws.
Instant Attunement. Tied around the neck of a creature dead no more than 10 days that wasn't Undead, it raises the creature as Raise Dead and instantly attunes to it; the creature dies if the attunement ends or the ribbon comes off.
Ribbon's Mending. When you drop to 0 Hit Points, you can use your Reaction to regain Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1). Once per dusk, or again after you roll a 20 on a Death Saving Throw.
Curse of the Ribbon. Other creatures within 60 feet take a -1 penalty to Death Saving Throws, growing by 1 each time you use Ribbon's Mending.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Haint Hooch
description:
Pungent blue-green liquor in a jug marked "XxX" with a skeletal grin. Drinking it makes you insubstantial for 1 minute: you move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain, taking 1d10 Force if you end your turn inside an object.
Heightened Potency. You also gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed for the duration.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Harvest Brew
description:
A thick orange brew tasting of nutmeg and cardamom, in a hollowed gourd. It nourishes you for a day, and for 1 hour whenever you regain Hit Points you regain extra equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Heightened Potency. The extra healing equals half your level (minimum 2) instead.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Hide of the Brimstone Behemoth
description:
A cloak of a magma fiend's reptilian hide from which flame recoils. While worn it grants its rarity's bonus to AC and Constitution saves.
Deep-Dweller (Rare+). You have Resistance to Fire and a Burrow Speed equal to your Speed; once on your turn when you surface, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation makes a Dexterity save (DC 16 + the bonus), taking 2d8 Fire or half on success.
Infernal Roar (Rare+). You can cast Fear (save DC 16 + the bonus) three times, regaining uses at dusk.
Hellfire Maw (Very Rare+). As a Magic action you breathe a 30-foot Cone; each creature makes a Dexterity save (DC 16 + the bonus), taking 4d6 Fire plus 4d6 Necrotic and being unable to heal for 1 minute, or half damage only on success. Once per dusk.
Pernicious Fire Immunity (Legendary). You are immune to Fire. Fire-dealing attacks aimed at you strike a random other creature in range (possibly the attacker), and when you save against a Fire effect you can give Disadvantage to one other creature saving against it.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Hook of the Tall Man
description:
A huge glowing claw on a bleached fingerbone hafted in ash, cut from the Tall Man's hand. It grants its rarity's bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Snare (Rare+). On a hit you can apply the Topple mastery in addition to another mastery you use with it.
Fey Haunt's Stride (Rare+). You can cast Misty Step from it, gaining Advantage on your next Dexterity (Stealth) check before the end of your next turn. Twice, regaining uses when you roll Initiative.
Strike from Shadows (Very Rare+). If you start your turn Invisible, your first attack that turn has Advantage and deals an extra 2d6 Piercing on a hit.
Hunter's Hook (Legendary). An Opportunity Attack hit with it deals an extra 2d6 Psychic and sets the target's Speed to 0 for the turn.
Terrifying Stride (Legendary). Right after Fey Haunt's Stride, a creature within 20 feet makes a DC 19 Wisdom save or is Frightened until the end of your next turn, unable to Disengage.
book: The Crooked Moon Part One: Player Options & Campaign Setting

name: Hypnovulfen Figure
description:
A carved wooden crooked wolf with leering eyes. While holding it you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus and gain +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
Hypnovulfen Bite. Your teeth sharpen; your bite Unarmed Strike deals 1d6 Piercing.
