description: Ground mouruge bones, rotten meat and mud. For 1 hour your Strength becomes 19 (unless higher), but you have Disadvantage on Intelligence checks and saves.

name: Hearthfire Breastplate
description: A corrupted, writhing black breastplate attuned in tiers. Aspirant: +2 AC and saves and cast Shield a number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus, but Disadvantage on Dexterity saves. Adept: that many times per Long Rest, as a Magic action, give up to six visible creatures within 30 feet 1d4 + 5 Temporary Hit Points (others gain +2 AC while they last), but you take unavoidable Psychic damage equal to half of those Temporary Hit Points lost by allies within 60 feet. Master: once per Long Rest, as a Reaction, make a damaged creature within 30 feet immune to all damage until your next turn, but you are Frightened for 1 minute when an ally drops to 0 (Paralyzed if it dies; DC 16 Wisdom save at end of each turn).

name: Heaven's Herald
description: An untarnishable golden trumpet heard 600 feet away. Once per dawn, as a Magic action, embolden up to 12 willing creatures within 600 feet for 8 hours: immunity to Frightened, Advantage on Wisdom saves, and Hit Point maximum and current Hit Points raised by 2d10. A Fiend or Undead who blows it takes 8d6 Radiant.

name: Hogs' Wash
description: Foul tea of powdered doom boar tusk. Drinking it grants the effect of Remove Curse, and it can serve as a component in removing a Shadowsteel curse.

name: Humble Frock
description: While wearing it without armor, Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage. At Stage 2+ of the Seraph Transformation, you have Advantage on saves to avoid revealing your true nature.

name: Hunter's Zeal
description: A glowing green tonic. For 1 hour you are immune to Poison damage and Poisoned and have Advantage on saves against being cursed; when it ends you gain 1 Exhaustion level.

name: Indorius's Crown
description: An emperor's crown attuned in tiers. Aspirant: Advantage on Charisma checks and saves, and 12 charges (regains 2d4 + 4 at dawn) for Compulsion (4), Dominate Person (5), Hellish Rebuke (1), Hold Person (2) or Suggestion (2), DC 18; but Disadvantage on Insight checks and Wisdom saves. Adept: a number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus, as a Bonus Action a Friendly creature uses its Reaction to attack or cast a level 2 or lower action spell, and conscious, you give Friendly creatures within 10 feet +1d4 to attacks and saves; but allies within 10 feet who miss or fail a check are Frightened of you until their next turn ends. Master: treat any Charisma check roll as 14 if you wish, and cast Dominate Monster or Power Word Stun (DC 18) once per Long Rest; but with no Friendly creature within 10 feet you have Disadvantage on attacks and can't concentrate.

name: Inquisitor's Draught
description: A silver syrup. For 1 hour after drinking it you can't attune to magic items and can take an action to sever all attunements, even cursed ones; if you are attuned to any item when the hour ends, you die.

name: Iridescent Armor
description: A giant dragonfly carapace breastplate with a gossamer cape, granting +1 AC. Once per dawn, as a Magic action, the cape becomes wings giving a 30-foot Fly Speed for 1 hour (60 feet for 2 hours at Stage 1+ of the Fey Transformation).

name: Iron Fangs
description: Rune-inscribed iron tooth caps. Your Bite attacks gain +2 to attack and damage and deal your choice of Force or Piercing damage.

name: Living Net
description: A suture golem net of wire and thread that writhes once it restrains a target. Escaping needs a DC 15 Athletics check; it has AC 15 and 15 Hit Points and repairs itself 1 minute after being destroyed.

name: Lodestone Armor
description: Plate lined with planar lodestone. As a Bonus Action, magnetize it for 1 minute, drawing debris for +1 AC and -5 feet of Speed; repeating while active stacks up to +4 AC and -20 feet, after which it can't be reactivated until it ends.

name: Magebane Bomb
description: Distilled magebane ooze. Make a ranged weapon attack against a weapon, armor or spellcaster; on a hit it deals 3 (1d6) Acid and a weapon takes -1 to attack and damage or armor -1 AC until its owner's next Long Rest, while a spellcaster takes -1 to spell attacks and spell save DCs for 1 minute.

name: Magical Prosthetics
description: A prosthetic limb (see the Grim Hollow Player's Guide) enchanted to replicate a wondrous item or ring suited to that body part, such as a leg acting as Boots of Elvenkind or a hand as a Ring of Protection. It has the same rarity as the mimicked item and occupies that item's slot.

name: Malleus Macabre
description: A jagged greatclub, the object form of a kokela, granting +4 to damage and critical hits on 19-20 (17-20 if you already have an expanded critical range). On a Critical Hit, after damage, there is a 25% chance it casts Cloudkill at level 9 centered on you. Curse: attuning curses you until you spend a year at least a mile from it; you keep it within reach and have Disadvantage with other weapons unless no foe is within 60 feet.

name: Mask of the Maestro
description: A yew beast-face mask with 3 charges; spend 1 to cast Polymorph on yourself for up to 1 minute. Curse: wearing it curses you so you can't remove it until Remove Curse or similar magic.

name: Morose Monocle
description: An opaque grey monocle through which you see only grief eaters and creatures in significant pain, sorrow or guilt, as glowing outlines within 60 feet. You have Advantage on Insight checks to gauge emotions.

name: Mortal Coil
description: A ring of woven rose gold wire. If you die while wearing it, your soul enters the ring and your body stays Stable at 0 Hit Points; when you regain Hit Points your soul returns and the ring becomes a lump of lead.

name: Muscle Graft
description: Bugbear vampire muscle grafted to your flesh. Your Strength increases by 2 (maximum 30); on attuning, make a DC 15 Constitution save or lose 2 Constitution. Curse: for 1 year or until Remove Curse you can't end attunement and crave raw meat and blood; each week make a DC 10 Constitution save or become a progenitor-less Vampire Spawn.

name: Net of Maiden's Hair
description: A sweet-smelling hair net of maiden's hair. While worn, you have Advantage on Persuasion checks and on checks to escape Grappled, which you can attempt as a Bonus Action.

name: Nightmare Staff
description: A twisted marra-remains staff with 3 charges (regained at dusk). When a visible creature within 60 feet damages you, use your Reaction and 1 charge: it makes a DC 13 Intelligence save or is Frightened until the end of its next turn, taking 2d6 Psychic if already Frightened.

name: Paragon's Plate
description: Fully enclosing ancient plate. You are immune to Unconscious and can act at 0 Hit Points while making Death Saving Throws; if you die, you keep moving and acting for up to 1 minute, unable to speak or cast spells. Curse: it can't be removed while attuned, and you automatically fail Death Saving Throws.

name: Paralyzing Bolt
description: A serpent-tooth crossbow bolt. A creature it damages makes a DC 15 Constitution save or is Paralyzed until the end of your next turn; it then becomes nonmagical.

name: Pharazorthok Sprout
description: A tentacled, eye-studded sapling. As a Magic action plant it in your space; while it is planted within 30 feet it whispers to you and grants Truesight 30 feet. A creature in its space can uproot it as a Magic action; if left planted 1 minute, it becomes a Roper hostile to you.

name: Pigskin Armor
description: Supple ogre swine hide armor that counts as Light armor. When you suffer a Critical Hit, roll a d20; on 17-20 it becomes a normal hit. While wearing it you snore loudly and eat twice as much.

name: Potion of Glacial Resistance
description: Salty, warming brew of keppmir horn. For 1 hour you can breathe underwater and have Cold Resistance.

name: Potion of Harm
description: A failed Potion of Heal, indistinguishable without level 3+ divination. Drinking it sets your Hit Points to 1d4; given to a creature at 0 Hit Points, it inflicts a Death Saving Throw failure and ends Stability.

name: Potion of Heal
description: Ebon liquid from a downcast vampire's remains. Drinking it restores all your Hit Points.

name: Potion of Life Sharing
description: A color-shifting draught of wolfentroika acid glands. For 1 minute, as a Bonus Action, a creature within 30 feet you can see or hear regains 4d6 Hit Points and you take that much unpreventable Necrotic damage. When it ends you gain 1 Exhaustion level.

name: Potion of Malice
description: Gripper spore sacs. For 1 minute you release spores; enemies within 10 feet make a DC 10 Wisdom save or must target you with their attacks, and their weapon attacks have Disadvantage.

name: Potion of Relentlessness
description: Viscous quoxxarie blood. For 1 minute, when reduced to 0 Hit Points you can spend a Hit Point Die to drop to 1 instead; afterward make a DC 15 Constitution save or gain 1 Exhaustion level per Hit Die spent.

name: Profane Charm
description: A fallen angel's charred feather wrapped in silver wire. While worn, you register as a Humanoid to Detect Evil and Good and similar effects.

name: Quakescale Armor
description: Quake drake scale mail that rumbles during storms, granting Thunder Resistance.

name: Queen's Token
description: A humble acorn from a Faerie queen. While holding it you can cast Wish, after which it returns to her. A wish she perceives as a threat to her or her realm fails and turns the wisher into an oak tree, reversible only by a Wish made with a Queen's Token.

name: Resuscitation Bomb
description: Reeking stinking sludge remains. As a Magic action throw it up to 10 feet to fill a 30-foot-radius Sphere: creatures there end Incapacitated, Stunned and Unconscious, dying creatures gain Advantage on their next Death Saving Throw, and all others make a DC 15 Constitution save or are Poisoned for 1 minute.

name: Ring of Hidden Desires
description: A rose gold band with an obsidian heart. Once per midnight, as a Magic action, a visible creature with Intelligence 4 or higher makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or you learn its greatest desire; on a success it becomes immune to the ring.

name: Ring of Nightmares
description: Made with restless lumberer brain. 3 charges (regains 1d3 at dawn): as a Bonus Action, spend 1 to make your next spell this turn deal Psychic damage. While attuned you are immune to magic that disturbs your sleep or causes nightmares.

name: Ring of Radiation
description: A braided copper ring. Your spells and abilities that deal Cold, Fire or Lightning damage have their range doubled.

name: Ring of Veracity
description: A gold band stamped with smiling faces. While attuned you have Advantage on Search actions using Insight, and once per dawn you can cast Zone of Truth (DC 15) as a Magic action.

name: Rod of Ruin
description: Stacked smoke-filled crystal spheres with 3 charges (regained at dusk). When a visible creature within 60 feet damages you, use your Reaction and 1 charge: it makes a DC 15 Constitution save or gains 1 Exhaustion level. With the Lich Transformation, it has Disadvantage and you gain 2d10 Temporary Hit Points when it fails.

name: Rod of the Pack Master
description: Wolf-and-bear carved driftwood. Once per dawn, as a Magic action, Polymorph any number of willing visible Humanoids within 30 feet into Black Bears or Wolves for 24 hours without Concentration, keeping their mental scores; end it early as a Magic action. At Stage 1+ of the Lycanthrope Transformation you can use it held in your teeth.

name: Sangromancer's Vial
description: A red glass vial filled with your blood during attunement: roll up to 10 of your Hit Point Dice and reduce your Hit Point maximum by the total, creating a pool of those dice to spend instead of your own on Sangromancy spells. Each Long Rest restores half the dice rolled; ending attunement restores your maximum after a Long Rest.

name: Second Skin
description: A harness of lycanthrope hides that melds into your flesh, setting your AC to 14 + Dexterity modifier. Use a Reaction to halve Bludgeoning, Piercing or Slashing damage from a non-silver source. You have Disadvantage on Charisma checks with lycanthropes.

name: Shadowsteel Blades
description: Lightless slashing weapons said to be forged from torn souls. You have Advantage on attacks against targets in Medium or Heavy Armor, and a creature hit makes a DC 14 Constitution save or is Stunned until the end of its next turn. A natural 1 on your first attack of a turn forces the same save on you.

name: Sizzling Serum
description: Volatile potbelly ichor. As a Magic action, hurl it at a visible Construct or object within 30 feet: it makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 10d6 Fire, half on success.

name: Soulbond Stone
description: A weighty stone with a dusk-colored gem. Pressed to a creature dead less than 1 minute, it captures a soul fragment; spend its 3 charges to cast Speak with Dead as if targeting that corpse. It shatters when the last charge is spent.

name: Staff of Briars
description: A staff of braerog claws with 10 charges (regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn; on spending the last, a d20 roll of 1 turns it to petals). As a Magic action, spend 1 to grow mundane thorny rose vines over a 20-foot square within 5 feet, making it Difficult Terrain.

name: Staff of the Sorcerer King
description: A scarab-carved ebony staff wielded as a +2 Spear (you are proficient while attuned). While holding it you have +2 to spell attacks, Humanoids take -2 on saves against your spells, and you have Advantage on saves against spells targeting only you. Curse: until Remove Curse you keep it within reach and have Disadvantage with other weapons; each midnight make a DC 17 Constitution save or lose 10 Hit Point maximum (unless Undead), restorable only by Wish, dying and rising as a Wight at 0.

name: Stalk Symbiote
description: An aberrant eyestalk stitched into a Humanoid's scalp to attune. It grants Advantage on Perception checks and no Disadvantage on Initiative when surprised; at Stage 1+ of the Aberrant Horror Transformation you gain Blindsight 10 feet. You can't end attunement voluntarily, and if removed it regrows in 1d4 hours unless Remove Curse is cast first.

name: Star Metal Ring
description: A steel ring set with star metal that crusts your limbs; your Unarmed Strikes are magical and deal Force damage.

name: Straitjacket
description: A strap-laden jacket taking 10 minutes to don or doff. Without armor or shield, add your Intelligence modifier to AC, and you can cast spells without Somatic or costless Material components, but you have Disadvantage on weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks. At Stage 1+ of the Aberrant Horror Transformation, roll twice on the Unstable Form table and choose.

name: Suit of the Lamb
description: Comfortable poffer-wool clothes granting Lightning Resistance and protection from extreme cold weather.

name: Sun Shades
description: Black leather goggles with cloudy lenses. While worn, you ignore Light Sensitivity and similar Bright Light penalties but can't see in Darkness even with Darkvision. Donning or removing them is a Utilize action.

name: Talisman of Tormach
description: A gore elemental's skull. When you kill a creature with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points for 1 minute; while you have them, those attacks deal an extra 1d6 Necrotic.

name: Thought Talker Orbs
description: A marble-sized Emitter Orb and fist-sized Receiver Orb. Touch them together as a Magic action to activate for 7 days: a creature entering or starting its turn within 5 feet of the emitter makes a DC 13 Wisdom save or the receiver's holder learns its surface thoughts for 1 minute (immune for 24 hours on a success).

name: Thricecall Mirror
description: An iron hand mirror of grasping hands. As a Magic action, speak an extraplanar being's true name into it three times to summon it within 5 feet; it keeps its free will, can't leave the plane for 1 minute, then returns home unless it can travel planes itself.

name: Toadstool Toddy
description: A fizzy fuchsia faerie draught tasting of autumn rain. A Humanoid who drinks it is immune to Fire and Cold damage for 1 hour.

name: Tormach's Blessed Weapon
description: A melee weapon blessed by the Lord of Blood Oaths. On a hit, the target makes a DC 15 Strength save or falls Prone; after one creature fails, not again until dawn. Each dawn roll a d20; on a 1 or 2 the blessing fades.

name: Ulmyr's Eye
description: A smoke-filled crystal ball attuned in tiers. Aspirant: you know Guidance, and 12 charges (regains 2d4 + 4 at dawn) cast Augury (2), Clairvoyance (3), Detect Thoughts (2), Divination (4) or Scrying (5), DC 18; but Disadvantage on Perception and Investigation checks. Adept: a number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus, as a Reaction, force a visible creature within 60 feet to reroll a D20 Test with Advantage or Disadvantage, and spend charges equal to spell level to cast your prepared spells; but after a Long Rest make a DC 14 Wisdom save or gain only a Short Rest. Master: cast Foresight (1 hour) once per Long Rest; but when you roll Initiative it casts Phantasmal Killer on you (DC 14).

name: Vilesmog Bomb
description: A smoky vial. As a Magic action, throw it up to 30 feet to fill a 15-foot-radius Sphere for 2 rounds; creatures entering or starting there lose Poison Resistance or Immunity and gain Poison Vulnerability for 1 minute.

name: Wand of the Poltergeist
description: A swirled wand topped with a screaming skull, with 7 charges (regains 1d6 + 1 at dusk; on spending the last, a d20 roll of 20 destroys it): Animate Objects (4), Major Image (3) or Shatter (2), using your spell save DC.

name: Wraps of Aphaeleon
description: Cloth fist wraps blessed by the Arch Seraph of temperance. On your turn, spend 3 Focus Points (no action) to end Incapacitated, Paralyzed or Stunned on yourself.

name: Armor of the Vampire Lily Dragon
description: Medium or heavy armor reinforced with vampire lily dragon spines, granting +1 AC. A creature that grapples you or hits you in melee within 5 feet makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 2d6 Poison and is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.
book: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons

name: Cherry Blossom Token
description: A pressed cherry blossom dragon flower. While carrying it you have Advantage on Performance checks to tell stories, and once per dusk you can reroll a failed attack roll, ability check or save, using the new roll.
book: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons

name: Clematis-tainted Weapon
description: A sword, arrow or dart coated in clematis dragon toxin. A creature you hit makes a DC 16 Constitution save, taking 1d8 Poison (half on success); on a failure it is also Paralyzed until the end of its next turn unless immune to Poisoned, then immune to the paralysis for 24 hours.
book: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons

name: Dandelion Hourglass
description: An hourglass of drifting dandelion dragon seeds. While attuned you have Advantage on Initiative, and once per dawn, as a Reaction when a visible creature within 120 feet rolls Initiative, it makes a DC 15 Intelligence save (it can choose to fail) or must reroll and use the new result.
book: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons

name: Floral Dragon Grooming Rake
description: Spend 10 minutes grooming a willing floral dragon to gain Advantage on Animal Handling checks with it for 24 hours, and it has Advantage on Dexterity and Constitution saves for 24 hours.
book: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons

name: Great Harvest Apple
description: An apple tree dragon's enormous apple that feeds up to ten creatures for a day. A creature that spends 10 minutes eating some regains 2d8 Hit Points, gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the number of others sharing the meal and gains Acid Resistance for 24 hours; once per 24 hours.
book: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons

name: Hydrangea Dragon Antidote
description: A viscous blue-pink brew of living hydrangea dragon blooms. Drinking it ends Poisoned, restores 2d12 Hit Points and removes 3 Exhaustion levels.
book: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons

name: Ornithogalum Dragon Elixir
description: A shimmering green distillate of ornithogalum dragon flowers. Drinking it removes 1 Exhaustion level and lets you spend Hit Dice as if taking a Short Rest.
book: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons

name: Ornithogalum Dragon Honey
description: Sweet herbal honey. One hour after eating it, make a DC 19 Constitution save or gain 1 Exhaustion level.
book: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons

name: Peony Dragon Essence
description: A fragrant vial with 1d4 + 2 doses. Add a dose as a material component when casting an abjuration spell to choose one: no Concentration needed for 1 minute, +1 to its spell attack or save DC, one extra target, or doubled duration.
book: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons

name: Succulent Water of Life
description: A light green liquid that turns dark red when shaken. Drinking it restores 1d10 Hit Points, then 1d10 more at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute while you have at least 1 Hit Point.
book: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons

name: Wisteria Dragon Perfume
description: A glass orb of wisteria perfume. As an action, throw it up to 60 feet to release a 20-foot-radius invisible cloud lasting 1d4 rounds; creatures starting or entering it make a DC 19 Constitution save (floral dragons other than wisteria with Disadvantage) or fall Unconscious for 1 minute, ending if damaged.
book: The Field Guide to Floral Dragons

name: Book of Dzyan
attunement_note: Requires attunement by a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check
description: A Celestial tome from a drowned civilization. Attunement requires a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check and ends only when a demon or devil casts remove curse on you. Benefits: see invisible within 30 feet; read and write Abyssal and Infernal; spellcasters always have guidance, detect magic, locate object, fly, divination, contact deity, and call deity prepared; touch reveals secret doors within 5 feet; advantage on Insight checks, learning a creature's secret on a 20 or higher (once per creature); +1 spell save DC. Drawback: when you meet a new kind of creature, roll a d20 each turn and on a 10 or higher spend your action studying it. Dreadful Insight: Insatiable Curiosity (+15). Lore: auto-succeed DC 25 or lower checks about planar creatures.

name: Necronomicon
attunement_note: Requires attunement by a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check
description: The most infamous Mythos tome, written in Infernal. Attunement requires a DC 20 Intelligence (Arcana) check and ends only by defeating a Mythos deity. Benefits: double proficiency on Intelligence checks; read and write Abyssal, Celestial, Draconic, and Primordial; spellcasters always have evil eye, dread curse of Azathoth, dust of Suleiman, and Voorish sign prepared; ghouls and ghasts won't attack you unprovoked; skeletons and zombies obey your commands; Mythos deities target you only as a last resort and you have advantage on Charisma checks to sway them; one extra spell slot of each level you can use; +2 spell save DC. Drawback: each midnight roll a d20, gaining a Doom point on 10 or higher; at 20 points you vanish. Dreadful Insight: Compulsion to Annihilation (+20). Lore: auto-succeed checks about undead and DC 20 or lower checks about the Mythos.

name: Pnakotic Manuscripts
attunement_note: Requires attunement by a DC 15 Intelligence (Religion) check
description: A Primordial text from a pre-human species that teaches movement between time's beats. Attunement requires a DC 15 Intelligence (Religion) check and ends with remove curse. Benefits: double your Initiative bonus, +10 Speed, advantage on Dexterity saves, +1 AC, and once per turn while moving you can teleport back to a spot you occupied during that move. Drawback: accelerated aging that compounds weekly and persists across re-attunement. Dreadful Insight: No Time to Tarry (+15). Lore: auto-succeed checks about time.

name: Seven Cryptical Books of Hsan
attunement_note: Requires attunement by a DC 20 Intelligence (Religion) check
description: Seven Celestial scrolls on gods, the world, and the planes. Attunement requires a DC 20 Intelligence (Religion) check and ends after visiting all seven realms they open. Benefits: prepare one extra cleric spell per spell level, +1 DC for cleric-list spells, advantage on Wisdom saves, one extra spell slot of your highest level, and cast gate once per day (Wisdom) to the next of seven realms described in the books. Drawback: each week without using the gate gives a level of exhaustion that remains until you do. Dreadful Insight: Enemy of the Dark (+20). Lore: auto-succeed checks about dead gods.

name: The King in Yellow
attunement_note: Requires attunement by a DC 15 Charisma (Performance) check
description: A thin volume holding a dreamlike play. Inspecting it compels a DC 15 Charisma (Performance) check; success attunes you, and attunement ends only by meeting Hastur. Benefits: advantage on Performance checks and on Deception checks built on the play; cast contact deity (always Hastur) once per long rest; after each long rest roll a d20, and on a 1 you can cast call deity to summon Hastur, gaining unremovable exhaustion if you don't. Drawback: disadvantage on Perception, Insight, and Investigation checks. Dreadful Insight: Lost Carcosa (+20). Lore: auto-succeed checks about Hastur.

name: Adamant Scale
description: When you cast Mage Armor, you can consume this item: the base AC becomes 15 plus the target's Dexterity modifier, and Critical Hits against the target become normal hits for the duration.

name: Distorted Hourglass
description: When you cast Haste or Slow, you can consume this item: you cast both spells but concentrate on only one; losing Concentration ends both.

name: Dragon's Wingscale
description: When you cast Dragon's Breath, you can consume this item: the target also gains a 30-foot Fly Speed for the duration.

name: Gilded Pate
description: A gilded skull usable as a Memento Mori. When you use it as a Spellcasting Focus, you can change a spell's damage to Necrotic or Radiant, or with a level 1+ spell force one target to succeed on a Wisdom save against your spell save DC or be Frightened until the end of its next turn.

name: Grimoire of Stolen Secrets
description: A blank tome. A Spell Scroll left tucked inside for 8 hours is consumed and its spell inscribed. You always have its spells prepared and on your class spell lists; it holds up to 5 spells of level 5 or lower and blanks when attunement ends.

name: Iron Feather
description: When you cast Forced Hesitation, you can consume this item: a target that fails its save also reduces its Initiative by the two highest damage dice combined.

name: Jade Toadstool
description: When you cast Revivify, you can consume this item: in place of the diamond, and the target revives with full Hit Points.

name: Leaden Mirror
description: When you cast Counterspell, you can consume this item: if the target fails its save, it also loses the spell slot and takes 1d6 Force damage per spell level.

name: Magic Magnifier
description: When you cast Ensorcelled Strike, you can consume this item: if the attack hits, the target takes an extra 3d6 Force damage the first time a spell damages it before the end of your next turn.

name: Magiceramic Mask
description: When you cast Arcanist's Magic Aura, you can consume this item: you can target an unwilling creature, which must succeed on a Charisma save against your spell save DC or suffer the spell's Mask effect for the duration.

name: Miniature Multiverse Model
description: A mithril model of the cosmos usable as an Astrolabe. As a Spellcasting Focus it grants +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DCs. As a Reaction, when a creature you can see within 60 feet makes a D20 Test, you can give it Advantage or Disadvantage.

name: Necklace of Fangs
description: Vampire and werebeast teeth usable as a Memento Mori. It has 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn (on the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it melts, leaving permanent bite marks). As a Magic action expend 1: a creature within 30 feet makes a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking 6d6 Piercing damage or half on a success, and you regain Hit Points equal to the damage.

name: Pickled Pixie Heart
description: A preserved fairy heart in a vial, usable as a Memento Mori. It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn (on the last charge, roll 1d10; on a 1 it dissolves). Expend 1 to cast Misty Step; chosen creatures within 5 feet of where you left make a DC 14 Constitution save or are Poisoned for 1 minute (save ends at end of each turn).

name: Polychromatic Prism
description: When you cast Chromatic Orb, you can consume this item: you can choose Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage, and it deals an extra 2d8 damage.

name: Restless Cremains
description: A trembling vial of ashes usable as a Memento Mori. It has 9 charges, regaining 1d6 + 3 at dawn (on the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it crumbles). When you cast a spell using it as a focus, expend charges up to the spell's level to summon that many friendly Dust Mephits within 60 feet, acting after you for 10 minutes or until reduced to 0 Hit Points.

name: Ruby Toadstool
description: When you cast Enlarge/Reduce, you can consume this item: the target's size changes by two categories and its 1d4 rolls become 1d8.

name: Scythe of Grim Harvest
description: A two-handed scythe usable as a Memento Mori. You have Advantage on attacks against Bloodied creatures. As a Reaction when a creature within 30 feet drops to 0 Hit Points, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to its CR or level and make one weapon attack. As an action, chosen creatures within 10 feet make a DC 13 Dexterity save, taking Slashing damage equal to 3d6 plus your level, or half on a success.

name: Starfall Spotter
description: A gold and silver star model usable as an Astrolabe. It has 12 charges, regaining 2d6 at dawn (on the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it vanishes). Expend 1 to cast Magic Missile or 4 to cast Fireball (DC 15), dealing Radiant damage.

name: Tiny Mithril Hammer
description: When you cast Magic Weapon, you can consume this item: its duration becomes 8 hours.

name: Witchwood Jaw
description: When you cast Animate Dead, you can consume this item: the Skeletons and Zombies can speak and understand your languages.

name: Animated Inks
description: Drinking it gives you a tattoo of a creature type you imagine, up to CR 1 (uncommon), 3 (rare), or 7 (very rare). As a Magic action the tattoo steps off you within 60 feet as that creature for 10 minutes, friendly and obeying you on your Initiative, returning at the end or at 0 Hit Points; usable once per 3 days. Ending attunement removes it.

name: Bonebreakers
attunement_note: Requires attunement by a Pugilist; brass knuckles
description: Battered brass knuckles. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Once per dawn on a hit, the target makes a DC 19 Constitution save or is maimed until Greater Restoration: Broken Arm (Disadvantage on weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks), Broken Leg (half Speed), Broken Ribs (Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and saves), or Broken Skull (Disadvantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks and saves).

name: Bottle of Brew Tasting
description: A bottle with a blank label; a liquid poured in has its contents and effects written on the label in Common until the bottle is emptied.

name: Bottomless Box of Treats
description: It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn. Expend 1 to pull out a treat; a Beast that eats it regains 3d4 + 3 Hit Points and removes one Exhaustion level or ends Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, or Paralyzed.

name: Club of Unconsciousness
description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a Critical Hit, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save or forgets the past minute and is Unconscious for 1 minute, ending if it takes damage or is shaken awake.

name: Coin of Easy Living
description: A gold piece that always lands on the side you call while it's in the air; you can summon it to your palm as a Bonus Action.

name: Everfull Stein
description: While its lid is closed and it's empty, name a nonmagical ale, beer, or mead as a Bonus Action and it fills with it.

name: Ferguson's Talons
description: Hand claws from a fabled feline. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While holding them you have 60-foot Darkvision and can cast Polymorph on yourself to become only a Cat. They have 9 charges: when you fail a Death Saving Throw, expend 1 to succeed instead; this property is lost at 0 charges.

name: Last Rites Rum
description: Drinking it deals 2d4 Necrotic damage to you; for 1 hour you have Resistance to Radiant damage and your Unarmed Strikes can deal Necrotic damage.

name: Leather Jerkin
description: While you wear no armor, this garment grants +1 (rare), +2 (very rare), or +3 (legendary) AC; you can use a Shield and keep the benefit.

name: Loaded Dice
description: Ordinary-looking dice. They have 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn: when you fail a D20 Test and aren't Incapacitated, expend 1 to reroll and use the new roll. You have Advantage on checks to win dice games played with them.

name: Mage Mashers
description: Heavy black-ore brass knuckles. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits deal an extra 1d6 Force damage to creatures that can cast spells, and creatures you damage have Disadvantage on Concentration saves.

name: Medallion of Mettle
description: Whenever you gain Temporary Hit Points, you gain an extra 1d6 Temporary Hit Points.

name: Mugfist Knuckles
description: Brass knuckles in obvious fake gold. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a Critical Hit, you gain gold pieces equal to the target's Challenge Rating (or level); below CR 1 counts as 0.

name: Penitent Pummelers
description: Gold knuckles etched with holy symbols. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Hits deal an extra 1d12 Radiant damage to Fiends and Undead.

name: Poundwise Porter
description: For 1 minute after drinking it, you gain +3 to attack and damage rolls with Unarmed Strikes.

name: Punchdrunk Punters
attunement_note: Brass knuckles, hand claws, or punch knife
description: Cask-soaked brawling weapons. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Each time you damage a creature it gains a Toxin Point for 1 hour (maximum 10). As a Magic action, a creature you can see takes 1d8 Poison damage per Toxin Point and loses them all.

name: Ramuh's Katar
description: A violet-metal punch knife. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Critical Hits deal an extra 2d6 Lightning damage. While attuned, you have Advantage on Initiative and can cast Jump on yourself.

name: Ratbite
description: Fur-clumped rat-tooth hand claws. You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While attuned you are immune to magical contagions. A creature it damages makes a DC 11 Constitution save or contracts Sewer Plague; on a Critical Hit it takes an extra 2d4 Necrotic damage and has Disadvantage on saves against magical contagions for seven days.

name: Salamander Sauce
description: Drinking it deals 2d4 Fire damage to you; for 1 hour you have Resistance to Cold damage and your Unarmed Strikes can deal Fire damage.

name: Spiked Collar
description: A spiked collar that gives a Beast wearing it a bonus to attack and damage rolls determined by the collar's rarity.

name: Studded Collar
description: A crystal-studded collar that gives a Beast wearing it a bonus to AC and saving throws determined by the collar's rarity.

name: Yggdrasil's Tap
description: An ironhard dark-wood punch knife. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a hit you can roll and expend a Hit Point Die: the target takes that much extra Piercing damage and you regain that many Hit Points.
